# Using the system

Install packages, import CSS, prefer framework components, consume Tier 2 tokens only.

## @eevenkoto/css

_Source: `packages/css/README.md`_

# @eevenkoto/css

Framework-free tokens, base styles, and component CSS for the Eevenkoto design system.

Source sheets live under `core/` and `domain/` (Atoms / Molecules / Organisms). Public import paths stay flat (`@eevenkoto/css/button.css`, …).

## Install

```bash
npm install @eevenkoto/css
```

## Usage

Import the base stylesheet once, then the CSS for each component you use:

```ts
import '@eevenkoto/css/styles.css';
import '@eevenkoto/css/button.css';
```

Import one sheet per component (flat paths). **Core:** `button`, `link-button`, `badge`, `status-dot`, `swatch`, `chip`, `heading`, `paragraph`, `list` (covers `List` + `ListItem`), `caption`, `frame`, `image`, `scroll`, `table-cell`, `icon`, `popover`, `inline-ref`, `avatar`, `input`, `checkbox`, `radio`, `select`, `toast`, `divider`, `progress-bar`, `property` (covers `Property` + `PropertyList`), `stat`, `flow`, `notice`, `field`, `checkbox-group`, `radio-group`, `stepper`, `segmented-control`, `card`, `tooltip-card`, `menu`, `catalog` (covers `Catalog` + `CatalogTile`), `prose`, `table`, `floating-banner`, `disclosure`, `chip-group`, `table-of-contents`, `section-header`, `table-shell`, `workshop`, `tier-card`, `account-menu`. **Domain:** `ability-name`, `entity-ref`, `ability-score` (covers `AbilityScore` + `AbilityScoreGroup`), `statblock-feature`, `statblock-section`, `statblock`, `spellblock`, `equipment-block`, `equipment-workshop`, `license-bar`, `document-header`, `content-table`, `entity-preview`, `read-aloud-box`, `npc-card`, `npc-card-grid`, `map-frame`, `content-gate`. Composed organisms such as `Statblock`, `Spellblock`, and `EquipmentBlock` import their atom/molecule companion sheets explicitly (for example `heading.css`, `caption.css`, `badge.css`, `chip.css`, `list.css`, `notice.css`, `button.css`, and `ability-name.css` for `EquipmentBlock`; see each component’s Storybook **Framework packages** section).

`styles.css` pulls Inter/Outfit from Google Fonts.

Also available:

- `@eevenkoto/css/tokens.css` — Tier 2 semantics + single-tier metrics (+ Tier 1 primitives)
- `@eevenkoto/css/primitive-tokens.css` — Tier 1 only (**never import in apps**; internal mapping layer)

## Theming & dark mode

Set `data-theme="light"` (default) or `data-theme="dark"` on `<html>` (or `<body>`), or `data-surface-mode="dark"` on a local dark container. All Tier 2 color roles (`surface-*`, `content-*`, `boundary-*`, `depth-*`, `control-*`, `feedback-*`, `form-input-*`, `link-*`) remap automatically — do not maintain manual dark-mode overrides for individual semantic tokens.

## Consume / never

**Consume** Tier 2 semantic colors (`--eevenkoto-color-surface-*`, `content-*`, `content-accent` / `content-accent-strong`, `boundary-*`, `depth-*` including `depth-scrim`, `control-*`, `feedback-*`, `form-input-*` including `form-input-placeholder`, `link-*`) and single-tier metrics (`--eevenkoto-space-*`, `--eevenkoto-font-size-heading-*` / `body-*` / `control-*` / `caption`, `--eevenkoto-font-weight-regular` / `semibold` / `bold`, `--eevenkoto-line-height-tight` / `snug` / `body`, `--eevenkoto-radius-*`, `--eevenkoto-line-width-*`, `--eevenkoto-duration-1`…`4`, `--eevenkoto-ease-standard` / `ease-in-out`, `--eevenkoto-z-base`…`toast`).

**Customize components** via public `--eevenkoto-<component>-*` variables only (for example `--eevenkoto-button-bg`, `--eevenkoto-card-bg`, `--eevenkoto-prose-link-color`). Bare `<a href>` inside `.eevenkoto-prose` are styled automatically with `link-*` tokens; inside `feedback-*` containers (`Notice`), links default to `currentColor` with an explicit underline for contrast safety.

**Never** reference hue primitives (`--eevenkoto-color-turquoise-*`, `parchment-*`, `obsidian-*`, `gold-*`, `green-*`, `orange-*`, `crimson-*`, `purple-*`), rem ladder steps (`--eevenkoto-font-size-xs`…`3xl`), private `--_eevenkoto-*` bridges, `opacity` for disabled UI, global/container `text-box-trim`, raw `z-index` numbers outside `--eevenkoto-z-*`, or raw `oklch()` / hex in app or component stylesheets.

For agents & site upgrades: feed Storybook `http://localhost:6006/llms.txt` or `/llms-full.txt` (generated via `npm run generate:llms`), and see `docs/migration-0.12-frontend-gap-resolution.md` and `docs/migration-token-architecture-and-a11y.md` when upgrading a consuming site. Contributors editing this package: see root `AGENTS.md`.

## Markup

This package is CSS only. Apply the documented BEM classes yourself, or use `@eevenkoto/html`, `@eevenkoto/react`, `@eevenkoto/vue`, or `@eevenkoto/astro` to assemble them.

```html
<button type="button" class="eevenkoto-button eevenkoto-button--primary">
  Save
</button>
```

**Button vs LinkButton:** `button.css` is for `<button>` actions. Navigation CTAs and standalone action links (`primary` / `secondary` / `ghost`) that go to a URL use `@eevenkoto/css/link-button.css` on `<a class="eevenkoto-link-button">` — do not restyle Button as a link. In-prose references use InlineRef / EntityRef.

## Related

- `@eevenkoto/core` — shared prop types and className helpers
- `@eevenkoto/html` — vanilla HTML string renderers
- `@eevenkoto/react` / `@eevenkoto/vue` / `@eevenkoto/astro` — thin framework wrappers
## @eevenkoto/react

_Source: `packages/react/README.md`_

# @eevenkoto/react

Thin React wrappers around Eevenkoto’s BEM classes. Source lives under `core/` and `domain/` (Atoms / Molecules / Organisms); the package barrel keeps a stable public API. Styling comes from `@eevenkoto/css`; class assembly from `@eevenkoto/core`.

## Install

```bash
npm install @eevenkoto/css @eevenkoto/react react
```

Peer: `react` ^18 or ^19.

## Usage

```tsx
import '@eevenkoto/css/styles.css';
import '@eevenkoto/css/button.css';
import '@eevenkoto/css/flow.css';
import '@eevenkoto/css/prose.css';
import '@eevenkoto/css/heading.css';
import '@eevenkoto/css/paragraph.css';
import { Button, Flow, Heading, Paragraph, Prose } from '@eevenkoto/react';

export function Example() {
  return (
    <Flow>
      <Heading level={2} text="Section title" />
      <Paragraph text="Body copy." />
      <Button variant="primary" label="Save" />
    </Flow>
  );
}
```

`@eevenkoto/css` is an **optional peer** — import each component sheet (for example `@eevenkoto/css/badge.css`) or the UI is unstyled. Live Storybook docs under **Framework packages** show HTML, React, Vue, and Astro usage across published components.

### Core

- Atoms: `Avatar`, `Badge`, `Button`, `Caption`, `Checkbox`, `Chip`, `Divider`, `Frame`, `Heading`, `Icon`, `Image`, `InlineRef`, `Input`, `LinkButton`, `ListItem`, `Paragraph`, `Popover`, `ProgressBar`, `Property`, `Radio`, `Scroll`, `Select`, `Stat`, `StatusDot`, `Swatch`, `TableCell`, `Toast`
- Molecules: `Card`, `Catalog`, `CatalogTile`, `CheckboxGroup`, `ChipGroup`, `Disclosure`, `Field`, `FloatingBanner`, `Flow`, `List`, `Menu`, `Notice`, `PropertyList`, `Prose`, `RadioGroup`, `SectionHeader`, `SegmentedControl`, `Stepper`, `Table`, `TableOfContents`, `TooltipCard`
- Organisms: `AccountMenu`, `TableShell`, `TierCard`, `Workshop`

`Button` = in-page action. `LinkButton` = prominent URL CTA or standalone action link (`primary` / `secondary` / `ghost`; `href` required; import `@eevenkoto/css/link-button.css`). Never put `href` on `Button`. Inline terms use `InlineRef` / `EntityRef`.

### Domain

- Atoms: `AbilityName`, `EntityRef`
- Molecules: `AbilityScore`, `ContentTable`, `DocumentHeader`, `EntityPreview`, `LicenseBar`, `MapFrame`, `NpcCard`, `ReadAloudBox`, `StatblockFeature`, `StatblockSection`
- Organisms: `AbilityScoreGroup`, `ContentGate`, `EquipmentBlock`, `EquipmentWorkshop`, `NpcCardGrid`, `Spellblock`, `Statblock`

`Flow` / `Prose` / `Frame` / `Scroll` / `TableShell` use `children` (not a `content` string like `@eevenkoto/html`). For bare-tag reading content, compose both hosts: `<Prose className="eevenkoto-flow">…</Prose>`. `EquipmentBlock` (like `Statblock` and `Spellblock`) composes companion stylesheets alongside `@eevenkoto/css/equipment-block.css` (`heading.css`, plus `caption.css`, `badge.css`, `chip.css`, `list.css`, `notice.css`, `button.css`, and `ability-name.css` for the sections you render).

## Related

- `@eevenkoto/css` — styles (required for appearance; consume / never rules and theming live there)
- `@eevenkoto/html` — reference vanilla renderers
- `@eevenkoto/vue` / `@eevenkoto/astro` — Vue and Astro equivalents
- Repo `CHANGELOG.md`, `docs/migration-0.12-frontend-gap-resolution.md`, and `docs/migration-token-architecture-and-a11y.md` — upgrade & token migration checklists for consuming sites

For agents: feed Storybook `/llms.txt` or `/llms-full.txt` (generated via `npm run generate:llms`).
## @eevenkoto/vue

_Source: `packages/vue/README.md`_

# @eevenkoto/vue

Thin Vue wrappers around Eevenkoto’s BEM classes. Source lives under `core/` and `domain/` (Atoms / Molecules / Organisms); the package barrel keeps a stable public API. Styling comes from `@eevenkoto/css`; class assembly from `@eevenkoto/core`.

## Install

```bash
npm install @eevenkoto/css @eevenkoto/vue vue
```

Peer: `vue` ^3.5.

## Usage

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import '@eevenkoto/css/styles.css';
import '@eevenkoto/css/button.css';
import '@eevenkoto/css/flow.css';
import '@eevenkoto/css/prose.css';
import '@eevenkoto/css/heading.css';
import '@eevenkoto/css/paragraph.css';
import { Button, Flow, Heading, Paragraph, Prose } from '@eevenkoto/vue';
</script>

<template>
  <Flow>
    <Heading :level="2" text="Section title" />
    <Paragraph text="Body copy." />
    <Button variant="primary" label="Save" />
  </Flow>
</template>
```

`@eevenkoto/css` is an **optional peer** — import each component sheet (for example `@eevenkoto/css/badge.css`) or the UI is unstyled. Live Storybook docs under **Framework packages** show HTML, React, Vue, and Astro usage across published components.

### Core

- Atoms: `Avatar`, `Badge`, `Button`, `Caption`, `Checkbox`, `Chip`, `Divider`, `Frame`, `Heading`, `Icon`, `Image`, `InlineRef`, `Input`, `LinkButton`, `ListItem`, `Paragraph`, `Popover`, `ProgressBar`, `Property`, `Radio`, `Scroll`, `Select`, `Stat`, `StatusDot`, `Swatch`, `TableCell`, `Toast`
- Molecules: `Card`, `Catalog`, `CatalogTile`, `CheckboxGroup`, `ChipGroup`, `Disclosure`, `Field`, `FloatingBanner`, `Flow`, `List`, `Menu`, `Notice`, `PropertyList`, `Prose`, `RadioGroup`, `SectionHeader`, `SegmentedControl`, `Stepper`, `Table`, `TableOfContents`, `TooltipCard`
- Organisms: `AccountMenu`, `TableShell`, `TierCard`, `Workshop`

`Button` = in-page action. `LinkButton` = prominent URL CTA or standalone action link (`primary` / `secondary` / `ghost`; `href` required; import `@eevenkoto/css/link-button.css`). Never put `href` on `Button`. Inline terms use `InlineRef` / `EntityRef`.

### Domain

- Atoms: `AbilityName`, `EntityRef`
- Molecules: `AbilityScore`, `ContentTable`, `DocumentHeader`, `EntityPreview`, `LicenseBar`, `MapFrame`, `NpcCard`, `ReadAloudBox`, `StatblockFeature`, `StatblockSection`
- Organisms: `AbilityScoreGroup`, `ContentGate`, `EquipmentBlock`, `EquipmentWorkshop`, `NpcCardGrid`, `Spellblock`, `Statblock`

`Flow` / `Prose` / `Frame` / `Scroll` / `TableShell` use the default slot (not a `content` string like `@eevenkoto/html`). Composed molecules and organisms also expose named slots (`header`, `headerActions`, `footer`, `icon`, `badge`, `action`, `actions`, `caption`, `summaryLead`, `summaryMeta`, `controls`, `toolbar`, `preview`). Compose Prose with Flow for bare-tag reading content. `EquipmentBlock` (like `Statblock` and `Spellblock`) composes companion stylesheets alongside `@eevenkoto/css/equipment-block.css` (`heading.css`, plus `caption.css`, `badge.css`, `chip.css`, `list.css`, `notice.css`, `button.css`, and `ability-name.css` for the sections you render). CamelCase props become kebab-case in templates (`typeLine` → `type-line`).

## Related

- `@eevenkoto/css` — styles (required for appearance; consume / never rules and theming live there)
- `@eevenkoto/html` — reference vanilla renderers
- `@eevenkoto/react` / `@eevenkoto/astro` — React and Astro equivalents
- Repo `CHANGELOG.md`, `docs/migration-0.12-frontend-gap-resolution.md`, and `docs/migration-token-architecture-and-a11y.md` — upgrade & token migration checklists for consuming sites

For agents: feed Storybook `/llms.txt` or `/llms-full.txt` (generated via `npm run generate:llms`).
## @eevenkoto/astro

_Source: `packages/astro/README.md`_

# `@eevenkoto/astro`

Official **Astro** component wrappers for the Eevenkoto design system (`^4.0.0 || ^5.0.0 || ^6.0.0`), mirroring `@eevenkoto/core` and `@eevenkoto/html` 1:1 with native Astro `<slot />` composition.

Pair with **`@eevenkoto/css`** — components ship **zero bundled CSS**.

## Install

```bash
npm install @eevenkoto/astro @eevenkoto/css
```

## Usage

Import `@eevenkoto/css/styles.css` plus the component stylesheets you need in your Astro layout or page, then import components from `@eevenkoto/astro`:

```astro
---
import '@eevenkoto/css/styles.css';
import '@eevenkoto/css/card.css';
import '@eevenkoto/css/button.css';
import '@eevenkoto/css/icon.css';
import { Card, Button } from '@eevenkoto/astro';
---

<Card title="Aavevalo">
  <p>Luo haalea lyhty pimeään käytävään.</p>
  <Button slot="footer" variant="secondary" icon="copy" label="Kopioi" />
</Card>
```

### Named slots & pre-rendered inline HTML

Components accept both native Astro slots (`default`, `header`, `headerActions`, `footer`, `icon`, `badge`, `action`, `actions`, `caption`, `summaryLead`, `summaryMeta`, `controls`, `toolbar`, `preview`) and sanitized `*Html` props (`nameHtml`, `titleHtml`, `leadHtml`, `roleHtml`, `captionHtml`, `bodyHtml`, `descriptionHtml`, `valueHtml`, `paragraphsHtml`, `flavorHtml`, `typeLineHtml`, `svgHtml`) for Markdown/rehype build pipelines that pre-render `EntityRef` / `InlineRef` links.

### Recursive `<Menu>` & `attributes`

`<Menu>` supports arbitrary-depth `MenuGroupEntry` nesting via `<Astro.self />` and forwards `attributes?: Record<string, string | boolean | undefined>` (`data-*`, `aria-*`, etc.) onto rendered menu controls and `<details>` branches for client-side tree filtering.

### Core

- Atoms: `Avatar`, `Badge`, `Button`, `Caption`, `Checkbox`, `Chip`, `Divider`, `Frame`, `Heading`, `Icon`, `Image`, `InlineRef`, `Input`, `LinkButton`, `ListItem`, `Paragraph`, `Popover`, `ProgressBar`, `Property`, `Radio`, `Scroll`, `Select`, `Stat`, `StatusDot`, `Swatch`, `TableCell`, `Toast`
- Molecules: `Card`, `Catalog`, `CatalogTile`, `CheckboxGroup`, `ChipGroup`, `Disclosure`, `Field`, `FloatingBanner`, `Flow`, `List`, `Menu`, `Notice`, `PropertyList`, `Prose`, `RadioGroup`, `SectionHeader`, `SegmentedControl`, `Stepper`, `Table`, `TableOfContents`, `TooltipCard`
- Organisms: `AccountMenu`, `TableShell`, `TierCard`, `Workshop`

### Domain

- Atoms: `AbilityName`, `EntityRef`
- Molecules: `AbilityScore`, `ContentTable`, `DocumentHeader`, `EntityPreview`, `LicenseBar`, `MapFrame`, `NpcCard`, `ReadAloudBox`, `StatblockFeature`, `StatblockSection`
- Organisms: `AbilityScoreGroup`, `ContentGate`, `EquipmentBlock`, `EquipmentWorkshop`, `NpcCardGrid`, `Spellblock`, `Statblock`

`EquipmentBlock` (like `Statblock` and `Spellblock`) composes companion stylesheets that are imported explicitly alongside `@eevenkoto/css/equipment-block.css` (`heading.css`, plus `caption.css`, `badge.css`, `chip.css`, `list.css`, `notice.css`, `button.css`, and `ability-name.css` for the sections you render).

## Related

- `@eevenkoto/css` — styles (required for appearance; consume / never rules and theming live there)
- `@eevenkoto/core` — shared prop types and className helpers
- `@eevenkoto/html` / `@eevenkoto/react` / `@eevenkoto/vue` — vanilla, React, and Vue equivalents
- Repo `CHANGELOG.md`, `docs/migration-0.12-frontend-gap-resolution.md`, and `docs/migration-token-architecture-and-a11y.md` — upgrade & token migration checklists for consuming sites

For agents: feed Storybook `/llms.txt` or `/llms-full.txt` (generated via `npm run generate:llms`).
## @eevenkoto/html

_Source: `packages/html/README.md`_

# @eevenkoto/html

Canonical vanilla API for Eevenkoto: HTML templates + `render*` functions that return markup strings. Source lives under `core/` and `domain/` (Atoms / Molecules / Organisms); the package barrel keeps a stable public API.

## Install

```bash
npm install @eevenkoto/css @eevenkoto/html
```

## Usage

CSS is not injected for you — import it explicitly:

```ts
import '@eevenkoto/css/styles.css';
import '@eevenkoto/css/button.css';
import { renderButton } from '@eevenkoto/html';

document.body.innerHTML = renderButton({
  variant: 'primary',
  label: 'Save',
});
```

`@eevenkoto/css` is an **optional peer** — import it in the host or markup is unstyled.

**Core atoms:** `renderAvatar`, `renderBadge`, `renderButton`, `renderCaption`, `renderCheckbox`, `renderChip`, `renderDivider`, `renderFrame`, `renderHeading`, `renderIcon`, `renderImage`, `renderInlineRef`, `renderInput`, `renderLinkButton`, `renderListItem`, `renderParagraph`, `renderPopover`, `renderProgressBar`, `renderProperty`, `renderRadio`, `renderScroll`, `renderSelect`, `renderStat`, `renderStatusDot`, `renderSwatch`, `renderTableCell`, `renderToast`.

**Core molecules:** `renderCard`, `renderCatalog`, `renderCatalogTile`, `renderCheckboxGroup`, `renderChipGroup`, `renderDisclosure`, `renderField`, `renderFloatingBanner`, `renderFlow`, `renderList`, `renderMenu`, `renderNotice`, `renderPropertyList`, `renderProse`, `renderRadioGroup`, `renderSectionHeader`, `renderSegmentedControl`, `renderStepper`, `renderTable`, `renderTableOfContents`, `renderTooltipCard`.

**Core organisms:** `renderAccountMenu`, `renderTableShell`, `renderTierCard`, `renderWorkshop`.

**Domain:** `renderAbilityName`, `renderEntityRef`, `renderAbilityScore`, `renderAbilityScoreGroup`, `renderContentTable`, `renderDocumentHeader`, `renderEntityPreview`, `renderLicenseBar`, `renderMapFrame`, `renderNpcCard`, `renderNpcCardGrid`, `renderReadAloudBox`, `renderStatblockFeature`, `renderStatblockSection`, `renderStatblock`, `renderSpellblock`, `renderEquipmentBlock`, `renderEquipmentWorkshop`, `renderContentGate`.

**HTML utilities:** `escapeHtml`, `sanitizeInlineHtml`, `slugifyId`.

`renderFlow` / `renderProse` / `renderFrame` / `renderScroll` take a `content` string (concatenate child HTML yourself). React/Vue/Astro use children / slots instead. `renderEquipmentBlock` (like `renderStatblock` and `renderSpellblock`) composes companion stylesheets alongside `@eevenkoto/css/equipment-block.css` (`heading.css`, plus `caption.css`, `badge.css`, `chip.css`, `list.css`, `notice.css`, `button.css`, and `ability-name.css` for the sections you render).

Class names and prop types come from `@eevenkoto/core`.

**Button vs LinkButton:** `renderButton` is for in-page actions (`<button>`). Prominent “go to URL” CTAs and standalone action links (`primary` / `secondary` / `ghost`) use `renderLinkButton` (`<a href>`). Do not pass `href` into Button. Terms in running text use `renderInlineRef` / `renderEntityRef`. Same-site pages with a real URL still use LinkButton.

## Related

- `@eevenkoto/css` — styles (consume / never rules and theming live there)
- `@eevenkoto/core` — shared contract
- `@eevenkoto/react` / `@eevenkoto/vue` / `@eevenkoto/astro` — framework wrappers over the same classes
- Repo `CHANGELOG.md`, `docs/migration-0.12-frontend-gap-resolution.md`, and `docs/migration-token-architecture-and-a11y.md` — upgrade & token migration checklists for consuming sites

For agents: feed Storybook `/llms.txt` or `/llms-full.txt` (generated via `npm run generate:llms`).
## @eevenkoto/core

_Source: `packages/core/README.md`_

# @eevenkoto/core

Shared prop types and pure className helpers for Eevenkoto. No DOM, no templates, no CSS.

Source modules live under `core/` and `domain/` (Atoms / Molecules / Organisms). The package root barrel keeps a stable public API.

Most apps use this indirectly through `@eevenkoto/html`, `@eevenkoto/react`, `@eevenkoto/vue`, or `@eevenkoto/astro`.

## Install

```bash
npm install @eevenkoto/core
```

## Usage

```ts
import { buttonClassNames, type ButtonProps } from '@eevenkoto/core';

const className = buttonClassNames({
  variant: 'primary',
  size: 'sm',
  icon: 'star',
});
// "eevenkoto-button eevenkoto-button--primary eevenkoto-button--sm eevenkoto-button--icon-left"
```

Helpers include `buttonClassNames`, `linkButtonClassNames`, `badgeClassNames`, `statusDotClassNames`, `swatchClassNames`, `chipClassNames`, `chipGroupClassNames`, `dividerClassNames`, `progressBarClassNames`, `headingClassNames`, `iconClassNames`, `imageClassNames`, `inputClassNames`, `selectClassNames`, `checkboxClassNames`, `radioClassNames`, `stepperClassNames`, `toastClassNames`, `fieldClassNames`, `disclosureClassNames`, `floatingBannerClassNames`, `tableOfContentsClassNames`, `sectionHeaderClassNames`, `menuClassNames`, `catalogClassNames`, `popoverClassNames`, `noticeClassNames`, `cardClassNames`, `tierCardClassNames`, `accountMenuClassNames`, `workshopClassNames`, plus Domain helpers (`abilityNameClassNames`, `entityRefClassNames`, `abilityScoreClassNames`, `statblockClassNames`, `spellblockClassNames`, `equipmentBlockClassNames`, `equipmentWorkshopClassNames`, `licenseBarClassNames`, `documentHeaderClassNames`, `contentTableClassNames`, `entityPreviewClassNames`, `readAloudBoxClassNames`, `npcCardClassNames`, `npcCardGridClassNames`, `mapFrameClassNames`, `contentGateClassNames`, …) and `ICON_NAMES` / `BUTTON_ICON_NAMES` / `iconPaths`. Full export list: `src/index.ts`.

Pair with `@eevenkoto/css` for styling.

**Button vs LinkButton:** in-page actions → `buttonClassNames` / Button. Prominent “go to URL” CTAs → `linkButtonClassNames` / LinkButton (`<a>`, never `href` on Button). Terms in copy → InlineRef / EntityRef. Chooser: Storybook Glossary.

## Related

- `@eevenkoto/css` — tokens and component styles (consume / never rules live there)
- `@eevenkoto/html` / `@eevenkoto/react` / `@eevenkoto/vue` / `@eevenkoto/astro` — markup bindings
- Repo `CHANGELOG.md`, `docs/migration-0.12-frontend-gap-resolution.md`, and `docs/migration-token-architecture-and-a11y.md` — upgrade & token migration checklists for consuming sites

For agents: feed Storybook `/llms.txt` or `/llms-full.txt` (generated via `npm run generate:llms`).
## Packages

_Source: `apps/storybook/src/foundations/packages.mdx`_

# Packages

Eevenkoto ships as separate npm packages so CSS stays framework-free and each runtime gets a thin binding.

| Package | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `@eevenkoto/css` | Tokens, base styles, and Core/Domain component CSS |
| `@eevenkoto/core` | Shared prop types + `*ClassNames()` helpers (no DOM) |
| `@eevenkoto/html` | Canonical vanilla API — HTML templates + `render*` |
| `@eevenkoto/react` | Thin React wrappers over the same classes |
| `@eevenkoto/vue` | Thin Vue wrappers over the same classes |
| `@eevenkoto/astro` | Thin Astro `.astro` wrappers with native slots over the same classes |

Source folders inside each package follow **Core vs Domain** and **Atoms / Molecules / Organisms** (see [Component taxonomy](/?path=/docs/foundations-component-taxonomy--docs) and [Glossary](/?path=/docs/foundations-glossary--docs)). Root barrels keep a stable public API.

## Source of truth

1. **CSS** defines appearance (`@eevenkoto/css`).
2. **Core package** defines the public prop contract and BEM class assembly (`@eevenkoto/core`).
3. **HTML** is the reference markup implementation used by this Storybook.
4. **React / Vue / Astro** only map props → the same class strings and elements (Flow uses children / default slot instead of a `content` string).

`@eevenkoto/css` is an **optional peer** of html/react/vue/astro: bindings assemble classes without injecting styles. Import CSS in the host app or the UI is unstyled.

Import styles explicitly in the host app:

```ts
import '@eevenkoto/css/styles.css';
import '@eevenkoto/css/button.css';
```

Component docs show HTML, React, Vue, and Astro usage under **Framework packages**. The live Canvas and Controls remain HTML-driven.

## Button vs LinkButton (marketing / agents)

| Situation | Use | Host |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Prominent “go to this URL” CTA or standalone action link (`primary` / `secondary` / `ghost`) | **LinkButton** | `<a class="eevenkoto-link-button" href="…">` |
| In-page action (submit, dialog, add/remove, open UI) | **Button** | `<button type="button" class="eevenkoto-button">` |
| Term or “read more” in running text | **InlineRef** / **EntityRef** (optional `href`) | not a CTA |

Do **not** put `href` on Button or wrap Button in an anchor. Same-site pages with a real URL still use LinkButton. Import `@eevenkoto/css/link-button.css` separately from `button.css`. Full chooser: [Glossary — Button vs LinkButton vs InlineRef](/?path=/docs/foundations-glossary--docs#button-vs-linkbutton-vs-inlineref).

## Theming & upgrading in consuming apps

- **Theme switching:** Set `data-theme="light"` or `data-theme="dark"` on `<html>` (or scope a dark region with `data-surface-mode="dark"`). `@eevenkoto/css/styles.css` includes `tokens.css`, which flips all Tier 2 semantic color tokens automatically (`color-scheme: light` / `dark`) — no host-app dark-mode CSS patches are needed.
- **Tokens & overrides:** Consume Tier 2 tokens (`--eevenkoto-color-*`, `--eevenkoto-font-size-*`, `--eevenkoto-font-weight-*`, `--eevenkoto-line-height-*`, `--eevenkoto-space-*`, `--eevenkoto-radius-*`, `--eevenkoto-line-width-*`, `--eevenkoto-duration-*`, `--eevenkoto-ease-*`, `--eevenkoto-z-*`) — never import `primitive-tokens.css` or set private `--_eevenkoto-*` component bridges. Customize components via public `--eevenkoto-<component>-*` variables (see [Tier 3 — Component scoping](/?path=/docs/foundations-color-tokens-tier-3-component-scoping--docs)).
- **Upgrading an existing site:** Follow `docs/migration-0.12-frontend-gap-resolution.md`, `docs/migration-token-architecture-and-a11y.md`, and `CHANGELOG.md` (also bundled into `/llms-full.txt` for coding agents).

## Authoring new components

Decide Core vs Domain and atom → molecule → organism first ([Component taxonomy](/?path=/docs/foundations-component-taxonomy--docs)). Host classes must ship usable defaults without modifier classes ([Minimum-class defaults](/?path=/docs/foundations-minimum-class-defaults--docs)). For multi-piece Domain UIs, see [Authoring composed components](/?path=/docs/foundations-authoring-composed-components--docs) — hierarchy, honest outlines, emphasis/contrast, package checklist, and HTML trust boundaries.

Product scope (content DS vs app kit, token-only controls): [Decisions](/?path=/docs/foundations-decisions--docs).
## Tokens

_Source: `apps/storybook/src/tokens/Tokens.mdx`_

# Tokens

Live catalog of design tokens that exist in CSS and Core today (color, typography, spacing, radius, line width, motion, layering, and icons). **Consume Tier 2 semantics and metrics — never hue primitives.**

This page is the **what exists** gallery. App consume rules are generated into `llms-full.txt` (served at `/llms-full.txt` when Storybook runs). Contributor rules live in `AGENTS.md`. Color tier governance for authors lives under [Color Tokens — Architecture](/?path=/docs/foundations-color-tokens-architecture--docs).

```css
/* Correct: semantic intent */
.eevenkoto-card {
  background-color: var(--eevenkoto-color-surface-raised);
  color: var(--eevenkoto-color-content-primary);
  border-color: var(--eevenkoto-color-boundary-subtle);
}
```

## Semantic colors

These are the **consumable** color tokens (Tier 2) currently defined in `tokens.css`. Use them in layouts, utilities, and as Tier 3 bridge fallbacks.

| Domain | Examples | Use for |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `control` | `--eevenkoto-color-control-primary-background` | Buttons, chips, and other contained actions |
| `surface` | `--eevenkoto-color-surface-canvas`, `surface-subtle`, `surface-sunken`, `surface-raised` | Page canvases, quiet stripes, sunken wells, raised cards/panels |
| `content` | `--eevenkoto-color-content-primary` | Body text, accents, and secondary/tertiary/disabled copy |
| `boundary` | `--eevenkoto-color-boundary-focus-outer` | Dividers and dual-halo focus rings |
| `depth` | `--eevenkoto-color-depth-shadow-umbra`, `depth-scrim` | Elevation shadows and modal/drawer backdrop scrims |
| `feedback` | `--eevenkoto-color-feedback-success-background` | Badges, notices, and status (subtle + solid) |
| `link` | `--eevenkoto-color-link-default` | Inline links |
| `form` | `--eevenkoto-color-form-input-background` | Text fields and validation |
| `control` (+ destructive) | `--eevenkoto-color-control-destructive-background` | High-urgency actions |

## Typography

Font families, weights, line heights, and **semantic font sizes** live in `tokens.css` (Tier 2). The raw rem ladder (`xs`…`3xl`) lives in `primitive-tokens.css` (Tier 1) — same rule as color: components consume semantic roles, never raw scale steps. See [Foundations → Typography](/?path=/docs/foundations-typography--docs).

## Spacing

Space scale for padding, gaps, and layout rhythm.

## Radius

Corner radius tokens for controls and surfaces.

## Line widths

Border and stroke widths.

## Motion

Duration ladder and easing curves. Components stagger properties the way Button does (`duration-1` → `duration-3`).

## Layering

Stacking order is a single-tier scale: `--eevenkoto-z-base` → `above` → `sticky` → `popover` → `overlay` → `drawer` → `modal` → `tooltip` → `toast`. Components and app shells use these instead of raw `z-index` numbers (Stylelint enforces it). `--eevenkoto-color-depth-scrim` is the backdrop colour for drawers and modals that the host app renders.

## Icons

Glyph inventory (`ICON_NAMES` / `iconPaths`) lives in **`@eevenkoto/core`** as `tokens/icons` — not inside the Icon atom. [Icon](/?path=/docs/core-atoms-icon--docs) and [Button](/?path=/docs/core-atoms-button--docs) both consume it. Cards with a primary border are also in `BUTTON_ICON_NAMES`.

Add a name + 16×16 path in `packages/core/src/tokens/icons.ts`; rebuild core. Do not paste ad-hoc SVG paths into components.

## Primitives (internal)

Hue pigments in `primitive-tokens.css`. Tier 2 maps these to semantic roles. **Components and product CSS must never import them.**

**Danger:** If you are styling a component or page and reach for `--eevenkoto-color-turquoise-*`, `--eevenkoto-color-parchment-*`, or `--eevenkoto-color-gold-*`, stop. Use a Tier 2 semantic token above, or add one in `tokens.css` with a designer.

For how primitives are authored and when new ones are allowed, see [Tier 1 — Primitives](/?path=/docs/foundations-color-tokens-tier-1-primitives--docs).

## Related

- [Typography](/?path=/docs/foundations-typography--docs) — Two-tier font sizes, families, usage rules
- [Color Tokens — Architecture](/?path=/docs/foundations-color-tokens-architecture--docs) — Author governance (not the usage catalog)
- [Tier 2 — Semantics](/?path=/docs/foundations-color-tokens-tier-2-semantics--docs) — Domain grammar, contrast tuples
- [Tier 3 — Component Scoping](/?path=/docs/foundations-color-tokens-tier-3-component-scoping--docs) — Private-bridge pattern
- [Button](/?path=/docs/core-atoms-button--docs) — Canonical consumer of control + metric tokens
## Typography

_Source: `apps/storybook/src/foundations/typography.mdx`_

# Typography

**Related:** [Tokens catalog](/?path=/docs/foundations-tokens--docs) · [Minimum-class defaults](/?path=/docs/foundations-minimum-class-defaults--docs) · [Typography sample](/?path=/docs/core-molecules-typography-sample--docs) · [Prose](/?path=/docs/core-molecules-prose--docs) · [Flow](/?path=/docs/core-molecules-flow--docs) · [Heading](/?path=/docs/core-atoms-heading--docs) · [Paragraph](/?path=/docs/core-atoms-paragraph--docs) · [List](/?path=/docs/core-molecules-list--docs) · [Caption](/?path=/docs/core-atoms-caption--docs)

Type roles and usage for UI. Live size specimens also appear under [Foundations → Tokens → Typography](/?path=/docs/foundations-tokens--docs). Color architecture is separate: [Color Tokens](/?path=/docs/foundations-color-tokens-architecture--docs).

Typography in Eevenkoto follows the same tier discipline as color: raw optical values live in Tier 1; roles that UI consumes live in Tier 2; component bridges live in Tier 3.

```
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Tier 1: Type scale (primitive-tokens.css)             │
│  --eevenkoto-font-size-xs … 3xl                        │
└──────────────────────────┬─────────────────────────────┘
                           │ Mapped to roles
                           ▼
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Tier 2: Semantic type & single-tier weights (tokens.css)│
│  heading-*, body-*, caption, control-*, font-weight-*  │
└──────────────────────────┬─────────────────────────────┘
                           │ Consumed by primitives / components
                           ▼
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Tier 3: Heading, Paragraph, List, Caption, Button, …  │
│  Private bridges + public override APIs                │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## Families

| Token | Face | Use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--eevenkoto-font-sans` | Inter | Body, UI controls, H4–H6 headings |
| `--eevenkoto-font-serif` | Outfit | Macro + H3 display headings |

## Heading hierarchy (multi-axis)

Six levels are grouped into three visual tiers. **Do not rely on size alone** — lower levels differentiate via family, case, posture, accent ink, and statblock banding.

| Visual tier | Levels | Primary tools |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Macro** | H1, H2 | Outfit serif, distinct size jump (`3xl`, `2xl`), bottom rule; H2 uses `content-accent` |
| **Meso** | H3, H4 | H3 Outfit serif (`lg`, `content-primary`); H4 Inter sans semibold (`md`, `content-accent`) |
| **Micro / Statblock** | H5, H6 | H5 Inter sans bold `all-small-caps` (`lg`) on a full-bleed `surface-sunken` band; H6 Inter sans bold italic (`md` = `body-md`, `content-accent`) / run-in |

Details and examples live on [Heading](/?path=/docs/core-atoms-heading--docs).

## Font sizes — two tiers

### Tier 1 (scale)

Sparse rem steps in `primitive-tokens.css`: `xs` → `3xl`. These answer “how large is this optical step?” **Never reference Tier 1 sizes from component stylesheets.**

### Tier 2 (semantic)

Role aliases in `tokens.css`. Grammar: `--eevenkoto-font-size-[role]-[variant]`.

| Role | Tokens | Typical consumer |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `heading` | `heading-1` … `heading-6` | Heading primitive (`1`→3xl, `2`→2xl, `3`→lg, `4`→md, `5`→lg, `6`→md) |
| `body` | `body-sm`, `body-md`, `body-lg`, `body-xl` | Paragraph, List, Stat (`lg`), document `body` |
| `caption` | `caption` | Caption primitive, Field hint/error |
| `control` | `control-sm`, `control-md`, `control-lg` | Button, Badge, Chip, Input, Select |

### Component size props (`sm | md | lg`)

Public size props across Button, Paragraph, List, and Badge use the same **`sm | md | lg`** names. Do not reintroduce `small` / `large`. Host CSS may omit `--md` (the base class is already md); framework helpers still emit an explicit `--md` when assembling class strings so the prop API stays aligned across controls.

| Prop value | Typical Tier 2 font role |
| --- | --- |
| `sm` | `control-sm` or `body-sm` |
| `md` | `control-md` or `body-md` (default) |
| `lg` | `control-lg` or `body-lg` |

Themes or density modes can remap a role without renaming the rem ladder.

```css
/* Correct: semantic intent */
.eevenkoto-button {
  font-size: var(--eevenkoto-font-size-control-md);
}

/* Incorrect: Tier 1 scale in a component */
.eevenkoto-button {
  font-size: var(--eevenkoto-font-size-md);
}
```

## Weights

Single-tier face weights in `tokens.css` (consumed directly by components and layouts):

| Token | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `--eevenkoto-font-weight-regular` | `400` |
| `--eevenkoto-font-weight-semibold` | `600` |
| `--eevenkoto-font-weight-bold` | `700` |

Italic bold is loaded for Inter so H6 can use bold italic posture.

## Line heights

| Token | Use |
| --- | --- |
| `--eevenkoto-line-height-tight` | Single-line controls and badges |
| `--eevenkoto-line-height-snug` | Multi-line headings (H1–H3), titles, outline navigation (`1.25`) |
| `--eevenkoto-line-height-body` | Paragraphs, captions, H4–H6, page body (`1.5`) |

## Content color

Pair type with `--eevenkoto-color-content-*` semantic tokens — never hue primitives.

| Role | Token | Typical component |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Body / titles | `content-primary` | Paragraph (default), Heading (H1, H3, H5) |
| Section & feature accents | `content-accent` | Heading (H2, H4, H6), StatblockFeature, AbilityScore label |
| High-emphasis chrome | `content-accent-strong` | Proficient Stat shield, EquipmentBlock emphasis value |
| De-emphasized body | `content-secondary` | Paragraph `--secondary` |
| Metadata / helpers | `content-tertiary` | Caption (default), Field hint |

## Caption vs Paragraph

| Need | Use |
| --- | --- |
| Multi-sentence body or supporting prose | **[Paragraph](/?path=/docs/core-atoms-paragraph--docs)** |
| One-line metadata, timestamp, or field helper | **[Caption](/?path=/docs/core-atoms-caption--docs)** |
| De-emphasize a full paragraph without making it metadata | Paragraph `tone="secondary"` |
| Quiet ink for Caption | Default (maps to `content-tertiary`) — not Paragraph secondary |

## Usage rules

- Prefer **Heading** for section structure; do not fake titles with bold Paragraph.
- Use **one `h1` per view**; do not skip levels only for visual size.
- Differentiate **H5/H6 with posture, case, and banding**, never a size smaller than `body-md`.
- Limit bottom rules to **macro** headings (H1/H2) and sunken section bands to **H5**.
- Use **Caption** for metadata and helper copy — not for main body text.
- Do not use **Paragraph `sm` + secondary** as a Caption substitute — size and ink roles differ.
- Button label size comes from **`control-*`**, not `body-*`.

See the [Tokens → Typography](/?path=/docs/foundations-tokens--docs) story for live specimens.
## Upgrading & Consumer Migration Guide

_Source: `docs/migration-token-architecture-and-a11y.md`_

# Migration & Consumer Upgrade Guide: Token Architecture, Contrast & Accessibility Overhaul

This guide explains what changed in the post-`0.9.5` token, contrast, Tier 3 scoping, and accessibility overhaul, and gives a step-by-step checklist for updating any site or application that consumes `@eevenkoto/css`, `@eevenkoto/core`, `@eevenkoto/html`, `@eevenkoto/react`, `@eevenkoto/vue`, or `@eevenkoto/astro`. For `0.12.0` component and recipe mappings, also see `docs/migration-0.12-frontend-gap-resolution.md`.

---

## Quick Upgrade Checklist (Run in Consuming Site)

Work through these 7 checks when bumping `@eevenkoto/*` in the consuming site:

1. **Search site CSS for Tier 1 primitive leaks, raw colors, and `opacity` disabled hacks** (see [Section 1](#1-audit-site-css-for-banned-tokens--raw-literals)).
2. **Replace any nonexistent legacy token names** copied from older CSS (see [Section 2](#2-replace-removed--phantom-token-names)).
3. **Adopt new & updated Tier 2 tokens** (`--eevenkoto-color-form-input-placeholder`, `--eevenkoto-color-content-accent`, single-tier `--eevenkoto-font-weight-*`, subtle wash invalid inputs; see [Section 3](#3-new--updated-tier-2-tokens-to-adopt)).
4. **Delete obsolete site workarounds** for dark-mode tokens and `.eevenkoto-prose a` inline links (see [Section 4](#4-remove-obsolete-site-workarounds-dark-mode--prose-links)).
5. **Verify component CSS customization uses public `--eevenkoto-<component>-*` hooks only** — never private `--_eevenkoto-*` bridges (see [Section 5](#5-component-customization-rules-public-vs-private-variables)).
6. **Confirm per-component CSS imports** include `@eevenkoto/css/ability-name.css` and all form/feedback sheets used on the site (see [Section 6](#6-verify-per-component-css-imports)).
7. **Update component props, heading levels, and test selectors** for `EquipmentBlock`, `AbilityName`, `Stepper`, and `Select` (see [Section 7](#7-component-markup-prop--selector-changes)).

---

## 1. Audit Site CSS for Banned Tokens & Raw Literals

Consuming sites must **only** import `@eevenkoto/css/styles.css` (or `@eevenkoto/css/tokens.css`) and consume **Tier 2 semantic tokens** and metrics. Never import `@eevenkoto/css/primitive-tokens.css` in app code.

Run this search across the consuming site's `.css`, `.scss`, `.tsx`, `.vue`, and `.astro` files:

```bash
grep -rnE "primitive-tokens\.css|--eevenkoto-color-(turquoise|parchment|obsidian|gold|green|orange|crimson|purple)-|--eevenkoto-font-size-(xs|sm|md|lg|xl|2xl|3xl)\b|--_eevenkoto-" src/
```

Every match in site code should be replaced:

| Never use in site CSS | Use instead (Tier 2 semantic token) |
| --- | --- |
| `@eevenkoto/css/primitive-tokens.css` | `@eevenkoto/css/styles.css` (or `@eevenkoto/css/tokens.css`) |
| `--eevenkoto-color-parchment-*` / `obsidian-*` | `--eevenkoto-color-surface-{canvas,subtle,sunken,raised}`, `--eevenkoto-color-content-{primary,secondary,tertiary,disabled}`, `--eevenkoto-color-boundary-{subtle,strong}` |
| `--eevenkoto-color-turquoise-*` | `--eevenkoto-color-control-primary-*`, `--eevenkoto-color-link-*`, `--eevenkoto-color-boundary-focus-outer` |
| `--eevenkoto-color-gold-*` | `--eevenkoto-color-content-accent` / `--eevenkoto-color-content-accent-strong` or decorative borders only |
| `--eevenkoto-color-{green,orange,crimson,purple}-*` | `--eevenkoto-color-feedback-{success,caution,critical,admin,info,neutral}-*`, `--eevenkoto-color-control-destructive-*`, `--eevenkoto-color-form-input-*-invalid` |
| `--eevenkoto-font-size-{xs..3xl}` | `--eevenkoto-font-size-heading-{1..6}`, `body-{xl,lg,md,sm}`, `control-{sm,md,lg}`, `caption` |
| `opacity: 0.5` on disabled controls | Component `disabled` prop, or opaque `--eevenkoto-color-control-*-disabled` / `form-input-*-disabled` / `content-disabled` tokens |

---

## 2. Replace Removed / Phantom Token Names

Several component stylesheets previously referenced unshipped token names that silently fell back or resolved to `initial`. If the consuming site copied any of these names into its own CSS, replace them:

```bash
grep -rnE "--eevenkoto-(duration-fast|easing-standard|font-weight-medium|space-(xs|sm|md|lg)|radius-base|font-variant-caps)" src/
```

| Broken / Nonexistent Name | Canonical Replacement |
| --- | --- |
| `duration-fast` (legacy) | `--eevenkoto-duration-2` (`100ms`; scale is `duration-1` `50ms`, `duration-2` `100ms`, `duration-3` `150ms`, `duration-4` `200ms`) |
| `easing-standard` (legacy) | `--eevenkoto-ease-standard` (or `--eevenkoto-ease-in-out`) |
| `font-weight-medium` (legacy) | `--eevenkoto-font-weight-semibold` (`600`; weights are `regular` `400`, `semibold` `600`, `bold` `700`) |
| `space-xs` / `space-sm` / `space-md` (legacy) | Numeric scale: `--eevenkoto-space-1` (`0.4rem`), `--eevenkoto-space-2` (`0.8rem`), `--eevenkoto-space-3` (`1.2rem`), `--eevenkoto-space-4` (`1.6rem`), `--eevenkoto-space-6` (`2.4rem`), `--eevenkoto-space-8` (`3.2rem`) |
| `radius-base` (legacy) | `--eevenkoto-radius-md` (`0.8rem`; scale is `--eevenkoto-radius-sm` `0.4rem`, `--eevenkoto-radius-md` `0.8rem`, `--eevenkoto-radius-full` `9999px`) |
| `font-variant-caps` custom prop (legacy) | Literal CSS `font-variant-caps: all-small-caps` |

---

## 3. New & Updated Tier 2 Tokens to Adopt

- **Input & search placeholders — `--eevenkoto-color-form-input-placeholder`:**
  `Input` and `Select` now consume `--eevenkoto-color-form-input-placeholder` (`>= 5.79:1` contrast in light and dark modes). Use it on any custom `<textarea>` or custom search input `::placeholder` on the site instead of `content-tertiary` or reduced `opacity`.
- **Readable accent ink — `--eevenkoto-color-content-accent` & `--eevenkoto-color-content-accent-strong`:**
  Small accent text (`< 24px` regular / `< 18.66px` bold) uses `--eevenkoto-color-content-accent` (`6.90:1`–`8.29:1` warm parchment primary in light, gold in dark), while high-emphasis gold chrome (such as proficient save shields and emphasis stat values) uses `--eevenkoto-color-content-accent-strong` (`5.04:1`–`6.05:1` deep gold in light, gold in dark). `Heading` (H2, H4, H6) and `StatblockFeature` consume `content-accent` automatically.
- **Readable `content-tertiary` on sunken wells:**
  `--eevenkoto-color-content-tertiary` (`Caption` default) now clears `4.85:1` even inside `surface-sunken` blocks and tables.
- **High-contrast invalid form fields:**
  `--eevenkoto-color-form-input-background-invalid` and `--eevenkoto-color-form-input-text-invalid` now render a subtle crimson wash with high-contrast dark/light ink (`8.72:1` light, `17.57:1` dark) rather than an inverted solid crimson fill. Always pair `invalid` inputs/selects with visible error copy (`Field` `error` + `messageId` + control `describedBy`) styled with `--eevenkoto-color-form-input-message-invalid`.
- **Single-tier font weights in `tokens.css`:**
  `--eevenkoto-font-weight-regular` (`400`), `--eevenkoto-font-weight-semibold` (`600`), and `--eevenkoto-font-weight-bold` (`700`) are now defined directly in `tokens.css` as single-tier metrics.
- **Canonical disclosure masks (`--eevenkoto-icon-mask-chevron-right` / `chevron-down`):**
  Available in `tokens.css` for CSS `mask-image` disclosure indicators (used by `Menu`). For DOM icons, continue using `@eevenkoto/core` `ICON_NAMES` / `<Icon />`.

---

## 4. Remove Obsolete Site Workarounds (Dark Mode & Prose Links)

1. **Dark mode (`[data-theme="dark"]` / `[data-surface-mode="dark"]`):**
   Set `data-theme="light"` or `data-theme="dark"` on `<html>` (or `data-surface-mode="dark"` on a local dark container). `tokens.css` now remaps **all** Tier 2 tokens in dark mode, including:
   - `--eevenkoto-color-content-disabled`
   - `--eevenkoto-color-control-primary-background-hover` and `-active`
   - `--eevenkoto-color-control-destructive-*`
   - `--eevenkoto-color-feedback-info-icon`
   - `--eevenkoto-color-link-default`, `link-hover`, `link-visited`, and `link-underline`
   - `SegmentedControl` `tone="secondary"` selected segment contrast (`17.29:1`)
   - `EntityRef` `kind="spell"` (`feedback-info-text`, `6.99:1`+ on all surfaces)

   **Action:** Delete any custom `[data-theme="dark"]` CSS patches the site previously maintained for these states.

2. **Bare inline links inside `<Prose>` (`.eevenkoto-prose`):**
   `prose.css` now styles bare `<a:not([class])>` inside `.eevenkoto-prose` with `--eevenkoto-color-link-default`, `link-hover`, `link-visited` (privacy-safe `:visited:not(:hover)`), `link-underline`, and dual-halo `:focus-visible` outlines.
   - Keep using **bare `<a href="...">`** inside `<Prose>` for normal editorial hyperlinks.
   - Use **`InlineRef`** for in-prose rule/glossary references, **`EntityRef`** for typed TTRPG entities (`condition`, `mechanic`, `ability`, `classFeature`, `feat`, `class`, `species`, `culture`, `background`, `spell`, `item`, `creature`), **`LinkButton`** for prominent URL CTAs or standalone action links (`primary` / `secondary` / `ghost`), and **`Button`** for `<button>` actions.

   **Action:** Remove custom `.eevenkoto-prose a` link color/underline rules from site stylesheets unless intentionally overriding `--eevenkoto-prose-link-color` / `--eevenkoto-prose-link-visited` / `--eevenkoto-prose-link-underline`.

---

## 5. Component Customization Rules (Public vs Private Variables)

- **Only set public `--eevenkoto-<component>-*` custom properties** on a host class or wrapper when customizing a component.
- **Never set or read private `--_eevenkoto-*` variables.** State-suffixed private variables (`--_*-hover`, `--_*-invalid`, `--_*-error`, etc.) in `Checkbox`, `Radio`, `Field`, `CheckboxGroup`, `RadioGroup`, `List`, and `EquipmentWorkshop` were refactored into stateless bridges.
- **`Button` & `LinkButton` custom backgrounds:** `--eevenkoto-button-bg` and `--eevenkoto-link-button-bg` now update both the solid fallback `background-color` and the P3 bevel gradient automatically — if the site previously added `background-image: none` just to make `--eevenkoto-button-bg` visible, you can remove `background-image: none`.
- **`SegmentedControl` `tone="secondary"`:** No longer clobbers host-level `--eevenkoto-segmented-*` overrides on the base selector.

---

## 6. Verify Per-Component CSS Imports

`@eevenkoto/css` does **not** bundle all components into `styles.css`. Import `@eevenkoto/css/styles.css` once at the app root, plus the flat stylesheet for every component rendered on the page:

```ts
// Always once at app entry:
import '@eevenkoto/css/styles.css';

// Import each component sheet your page/route uses:
import '@eevenkoto/css/ability-name.css'; // REQUIRED whenever AbilityName or EquipmentBlock with `abilities` is rendered!
import '@eevenkoto/css/equipment-block.css';
import '@eevenkoto/css/equipment-workshop.css';
import '@eevenkoto/css/input.css';
import '@eevenkoto/css/select.css';
import '@eevenkoto/css/checkbox.css';
import '@eevenkoto/css/checkbox-group.css';
import '@eevenkoto/css/radio.css';
import '@eevenkoto/css/radio-group.css';
import '@eevenkoto/css/stepper.css';
import '@eevenkoto/css/toast.css';
import '@eevenkoto/css/image.css';
```

> **Important for `AbilityName` & `EquipmentBlock`:** When abbreviated (`variant="short"` or inside narrow container queries), `AbilityName` visually hides `.eevenkoto-ability-name__full` via CSS clipping so screen readers still read the full ability name. If `@eevenkoto/css/ability-name.css` is missing on a standalone `AbilityName`, both full and short spans will appear inline.

---

## 7. Component Markup, Prop & Selector Changes

Check these four components in the consuming site (especially if the site writes raw HTML, CSS child tag selectors, or DOM/snapshot tests):

### 7.1 `EquipmentBlock` — Sequential Section Headings (`h2` / `h3` instead of `h4`)

Section titles (`Valitut piirteet`, `Säännöt & vaikutukset`) previously hardcoded `<h4 class="eevenkoto-equipment-block__section-title">`, skipping heading levels (`h1` → `h4`) and failing WCAG / `axe-core` `heading-order`.

- When `nameLevel` is `1` (default, standalone item page): renders `<h1>` item name → `<h2>` section titles.
- When `nameLevel` is `2` (embedded inside a page that already has an `<h1>`, such as a compendium list or `EquipmentWorkshop` page with a page `<h1>`): renders `<h2>` item name → `<h3>` section titles.

**Site actions:**
1. Pass `nameLevel={2}` (or `:name-level="2"` in Vue / `nameLevel: 2` in HTML) whenever `EquipmentBlock` is rendered underneath an existing page `<h1>` (for example inside the site's `EquipmentWorkshop` page if the page header uses `<h1>`).
2. Replace any site CSS or test selector targeting `.eevenkoto-equipment-block h4` with `.eevenkoto-equipment-block__section-title`.

### 7.2 `AbilityName` — Valid Inline Accessibility (No `aria-label` on `<span>`)

WAI-ARIA 1.2 prohibits `aria-label` on generic `<span>` elements (`axe-core` `aria-prohibited-attr`), and `display: none` previously hid `.eevenkoto-ability-name__full` from screen readers when collapsed.

- Root `<span class="eevenkoto-ability-name">` **no longer emits `aria-label`**.
- `.eevenkoto-ability-name__full` stays in the accessibility tree via visually-hidden CSS clipping when collapsed, while `.eevenkoto-ability-name__short` keeps `aria-hidden="true"`.

**Site actions:**
1. Props (`name`, `short`, `variant`) are unchanged across HTML, React, Vue, and Astro.
2. If the site hand-renders `.eevenkoto-ability-name` HTML without `@eevenkoto/html` / `react` / `vue` / `astro`, remove `aria-label` from the outer `<span>`:
   ```html
   <span class="eevenkoto-ability-name">
     <span class="eevenkoto-ability-name__full">Voimakkuus</span>
     <span class="eevenkoto-ability-name__short" aria-hidden="true">VOI</span>
   </span>
   ```
3. Update any test asserting `[aria-label]` on `.eevenkoto-ability-name`.

### 7.3 `Stepper` — WAI-ARIA Group & Disabled Semantics

Root `.eevenkoto-stepper` now renders `role="group"` and, when `disabled` is true, `aria-disabled="true"` across HTML (`renderStepper`), React (`<Stepper />`), Vue (`<Stepper />`), and Astro (`<Stepper />`) so assistive technology and `axe-core` recognize the entire composite control as disabled.

**Site action:** No prop changes if using `@eevenkoto/html`, `@eevenkoto/react`, `@eevenkoto/vue`, or `@eevenkoto/astro`. If hand-rendering `.eevenkoto-stepper` markup, add `role="group"` (and `aria-disabled="true"` when `--disabled` is active) to the root `<div class="eevenkoto-stepper">`.

### 7.4 `Select` — Grouped Options Prop (`groups` + optional top-level `options`)

When rendering `<optgroup>` groups in `Select`, pass them via `groups`. As of `0.11.0`, you can also pass top-level `options` alongside `groups` (for example a `"Kaikki"` reset option rendered above the `<optgroup>`s):

```tsx
<Select
  id="shield"
  options={[{ value: 'all', label: 'Kaikki suojat' }]}
  groups={[
    {
      label: 'Kevyet suojat',
      options: [{ value: 'buckler', label: 'Pikkukilpi (+1 PL)' }],
    },
  ]}
/>
```

### 7.5 Minimum-Class Host Defaults (`Stat`, `Badge`, `StatusDot`)

If the site applies raw BEM classes without `*ClassNames()` helpers:
- `.eevenkoto-stat` alone now renders `disk` + `md` (`4rem`, `border-radius: var(--eevenkoto-radius-full)`), matching `StatProps` defaults. Pass `eevenkoto-stat--sm` or `eevenkoto-stat--arch` / `--shield` when smaller or non-disk shapes are wanted.
- `.eevenkoto-badge` dot indicator defaults to `0.4em` (matching `--md`), and `.eevenkoto-status-dot` ring defaults to `surface-canvas`.

---

## 8. Upgrading to `0.11.0` (Astro Package, Ergonomics & `0.10.1` Bug Fixes)

When upgrading `eevenkoto_web` and `eevenkoto_teksti` from `0.10.0` to `0.11.0`, apply these four cleanup steps:

### 8.1 Delete `0.10.0` Bridge Overrides from Site `eevenkoto-ds.css`

All `0.10.0` rollout bugs are now fixed upstream in `@eevenkoto/css`, `@eevenkoto/core`, and `@eevenkoto/html`. Remove any local bridge CSS for:

1. **2-value `margin-block` fixes** on `.eevenkoto-heading`, `.eevenkoto-paragraph`, `.eevenkoto-caption`, `.eevenkoto-list`, and `.eevenkoto-statblock-section`.
2. **`h3.eevenkoto-heading--2` specificity workarounds** (`heading.css` now places `:where(h1..h6).eevenkoto-heading` before `.eevenkoto-heading--1..6` and resets padding/border on `--3..--6`).
3. **`.eevenkoto-u-visually-hidden` aliases and empty `CheckboxGroup` / `RadioGroup` header gap rules** (`checkboxGroupLegendClassNames(true)` and `radioGroupLegendClassNames(true)` emit `.eevenkoto-visually-hidden`, `hideLegend` omits `__header` when no `badge` is passed, and `columns > 1` automatically infers `layout: 'grid'`).
4. **Inline hidden `Toast` (`display: none`)**, **organism child margin resets** (`statblock > .eevenkoto-heading--2`, `spellblock > .eevenkoto-list`, `card header .eevenkoto-caption`), **`.eevenkoto-field__control > .eevenkoto-select` width**, **`Popover` `z-index` / `--fixed` cascade overrides**, and **`@media print` `.eevenkoto-inline-ref__lock` hiding**.

### 8.2 Replace Local `.astro` Wrappers with `@eevenkoto/astro`

Install `@eevenkoto/astro` alongside `@eevenkoto/css`:

```bash
npm install @eevenkoto/astro @eevenkoto/css
```

Replace local `src/components/*.astro` boilerplate imports with `@eevenkoto/astro`:

```astro
---
import {
  Button,
  LinkButton,
  Card,
  Menu,
  Notice,
  Popover,
  Workshop,
  Statblock,
  Spellblock,
  EntityRef,
} from '@eevenkoto/astro';
---
```

### 8.3 Adopt Compiler-Friendly HTML & Rich `*Html` Slots in Markdown Pipelines

- **Zero leading comments or trailing newlines:** All `render*` functions in `@eevenkoto/html` (including single-line `<details>` in `renderMenu`) now emit clean HTML without leading `<!-- ... -->` comments or trailing `\n`, safe to embed directly inside Markdown compilers (`eevenkoto_teksti`) and Astro `set:html`.
- **`sanitizeInlineHtml` preserves `EntityRef` / `InlineRef`:** `sanitizeInlineHtml` now keeps `<a href="...">`, `<span class="...">`, `data-*`, and `.eevenkoto-icon` `<svg><path /></svg>` intact while stripping `javascript:` URLs and event handlers.
- **Explicit `*Html` props across all bindings (`HTML`, `React`, `Vue`, `Astro`):**
  - `Property` / `PropertyList`: `valueHtml`
  - `Card` & `Notice`: `bodyHtml`
  - `StatblockFeature`: `descriptionHtml`
  - `StatblockSection`: `bodyHtml`
  - `Statblock`: `flavorHtml`, `typeLineHtml`, `bodyHtml`
  - `Spellblock`: `typeLineHtml`, `paragraphsHtml`, `bodyHtml`

### 8.4 New Ergonomics, Icons, Variants & Core `Workshop`

- **New icons in `ICON_NAMES` / `BUTTON_ICON_NAMES`:** `close`, `copy`, `refresh`, `reroll`, `logout`, `mail`, `info`, `warning`.
- **`LinkButton` `'ghost'` variant & `fullWidth`:** `<LinkButton variant="ghost" href="/..." />`, plus `fullWidth` on `Button`, `LinkButton`, `Input`, `Select`, and `SegmentedControl`.
- **`Popover` edge alignments & trigger width:** `placement="bottom-start" | "bottom-end" | "top-start" | "top-end"` and `matchTriggerWidth`.
- **`Menu` recursion & pass-through `attributes`:** Arbitrary `data-*` / `aria-*` attributes (`attributes={{ 'data-filter-tags': 'arcane' }}`) on items, groups, headers, and separators at any nesting depth.
- **Expanded `EntityRefKind`:** Added `'species' | 'culture' | 'background' | 'feat' | 'ability'`.
- **`Notice` defaults:** Automatically renders intent icons (`icon={false}` to opt out) and defaults `role="alert"` on `critical` and `caution`.
- **Core `Workshop` (`@eevenkoto/css/workshop.css`):** Use `<Workshop label="..." controlsWidth="24rem">` for non-equipment generators (NPCs, encounters, spells, character builders); `<EquipmentWorkshop>` remains supported for existing equipment pages.

Maps every item of the frontend briefing ("Frontend-to-Design-System Briefing", baseline `^0.11.0`) to what `@eevenkoto/* ^0.12.0` ships. ## Upgrade steps

1. Bump all `@eevenkoto/*` packages to `^0.12.0` together (they are version-locked).
2. Import component sheets you use, e.g. `import '@eevenkoto/css/tier-card.css'`.
3. Replace local components with the DS ones per the table; delete local CSS that duplicated them (progress bar, copyright bar, consent banner, gate card, tier cards, disclosure, chip groups, etc.).
4. Map `teksti`/`srd` to `proprietary`/`open` at your app boundary.
5. Keep client behavior in the app: sidebar/drawer, scrollspy (update `aria-current="location"` on `[data-toc-target]`), consent persistence, tier checks, and swatch selection state.
6. Prose renderers (`eevenkoto_teksti/build.js`, workshop preview renderers) can keep emitting HTML strings: every prose-bearing component accepts `*Html` via `@eevenkoto/html` (`renderX`), and `sanitizeInlineHtml` is applied where inline HTML is accepted.

## Breaking-change notes

None intended. `EquipmentWorkshop` now emits both `eevenkoto-workshop__*` and `eevenkoto-equipment-workshop__*` element classes; selectors targeting the old classes still match. The plain-cell markup contract of `Table` (no `eevenkoto-table-cell` base class under `.eevenkoto-table`) is unchanged.
