Use the prop that matches the role — do not force one name everywhere.

| Prop | Use for |
| --- | --- |
| `label` | Visible control/chrome copy and definition terms (Button, LinkButton, Badge, Property, AbilityScore header, **Field** visible label). **Not** used on Input. |
| `ariaLabel` | Input / Select / FloatingBanner: `aria-label` when there is no Field / visible label. |
| `text` | Typography primitives (Heading, Paragraph, Caption, ListItem, TableCell body, Toast) |
| `name` | Named entity or inline reference (Statblock creature, Spellblock spell, EquipmentBlock item, NpcCard, TierCard, StatblockFeature, InlineRef, EntityRef, AbilityName) |
| `title` | Section or surface heading (StatblockSection, Card, TooltipCard, SectionHeader, Workshop, ContentGate, MapFrame) |
| `value` | Numeric or definitional payload (Stat, Property, ProgressBar, Stepper) |
| `description` | Feature or option body after the primary label |
| `content` | HTML-only string body for composed hosts (Flow, Prose, Frame, Scroll, Popover); React/Vue/Astro use `children` / slots |

In markup, a Property `label` is the definition **term** (`dt`). The prop name stays **`label`**.

## Variant vocabulary

| Surface | Prop | Values mean |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Button | `variant` | Action hierarchy: `primary` / `secondary` / `ghost` |
| LinkButton | `variant` | CTA / standalone link hierarchy: `primary` / `secondary` / `ghost` (in-prose links stay InlineRef or bare `<a>`) |
| Badge / Notice | `variant` | Surface recipe: `subtle` / `solid` / `outline` |
| Toast | `variant` | Surface recipe: `subtle` / `solid` |
| Badge / Notice / Toast / StatusDot | `intent` | Feedback severity: `neutral` / `info` / `success` / `caution` / `critical` / `admin` |
| Chip | `selected` | Control selected / unselected |
| Heading / Paragraph / List | `tone` | Content weight: `primary` / `secondary` |
| Caption | `tone` | Content weight: `secondary` (default → `content-tertiary`) / `primary` / `accent` |
| List | `variant` | List kind: `unordered` / `ordered` / `checklist` |

`primary` is overloaded by design (control hierarchy vs content weight vs token slots). Prefer the table above over inventing parallel words.

Feedback uses **`caution`** / **`critical`** (not `warning` / `error`). Destructive actions use control **`destructive`** tokens / Menu `tone="destructive"` — that is separate from Badge intent.

## Button vs LinkButton vs InlineRef

Never put `href` on Button or wrap a Button in an `<a>`. Pick by **what happens**, not by how prominent it looks.

| Situation | Use |
| --- | --- |
| Hero / campaign “Start playing”, “Get the book”, “Read the rules” | **LinkButton** (`<a>`, required `href`) |
| Same-site page that is still a real URL | **LinkButton** |
| Form submit, dialog confirm, add/remove, open a modal or drawer | **Button** (`<button>`) |
| “Read more” or a term inside a paragraph | **InlineRef** / **EntityRef** (or a prose link) — not LinkButton |
| One main destination + quieter standalone destinations | LinkButton **primary** + **secondary** / **ghost** |
| Destination is not ready | Omit the CTA; do not ship a disabled LinkButton as the only signal |

LinkButton looks related to Button on purpose (marketing CTAs) but stays a link: end-scoop shape, hover translate, no visited purple. Button is for **doing**; LinkButton is for **going**.

## Form controls chooser

Pick the control based on **selection cardinality** (how many items can be chosen), **option count**, and **canvas space / scanning demand**.

| User Task / Scenario | Recommended | Why | When NOT to use |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Independent on/off toggle** (e.g. "I accept rules", "Equipped") | **Checkbox** | Standard binary switch. | Do not use Radio for standalone toggles. |
| **Multi-select from a list (0 to N)** (e.g. weapon traits, skills) | **CheckboxGroup** | Fieldset grouping checkboxes; supports budget `badge`. | If only ONE choice is allowed, use RadioGroup or Select. |
| **Compact filter chips / color swatches** (e.g. spell level filter, dye tray) | **ChipGroup** | Wrapping `<fieldset>` of `aria-pressed` Chips with `icon` / `swatchColor`. | For form submissions with native inputs/descriptions, use CheckboxGroup or RadioGroup. |
| **Single choice from 2–5 visible options** (e.g. Melee vs Ranged) | **RadioGroup** | All options visible for rapid comparison and arrow navigation. | If there are 6+ options or space is tight, use Select. |
| **Single choice from 6+ options** (e.g. 15 weapon classes, categories) | **Select** | Compact single-row height; mobile OS pickers; `<optgroup>`. | If options need instant visual comparison, use RadioGroup. |
| **In-page view switcher or mode toggle** (2–4 items) | **SegmentedControl** | Horizontal connected pill toolbar for view modes. | Not for form surveys or options with mechanics copy. |
| **Bounded small integer quantity or rank** (e.g. ranks 0–5, quantities 1–10) | **Stepper** | One-tap `+` / `−` adjustments with min/max bounds. | For large open-ended numbers (e.g. 500 gold), use Input. |
| **Free-form text, search, or large numbers** | **Field + Input** | Standard text-box surface with label and error copy. | Do not use for choosing from a closed predefined list. |

### Variant selection for Checkbox & Radio

- **`default` (inline)**: Compact, standard checkbox / radio circle with adjacent label. Best for simple one-line items in forms and settings.
- **`card`**: Rich card with title, optional description (mechanics copy), and optional badge (budget/tier). Best for item builders, spell selection, equipment loadouts.
- **`tile` (Radio only)**: Compact symmetric card with centered label and optional icon. Best in a 2–3 column grid (`layout="grid"`) for mutually exclusive modes, dice selection, or armor categories.

## Type layers

| Package | Canonical type name |
| --- | --- |
| `@eevenkoto/core` | `*Props` + `*ClassNames()` |
| `@eevenkoto/html` | `*Props` (HTML-only extensions stay as local `*Props` that extend core) |
| `@eevenkoto/react` | `*ComponentProps` (DOM attrs + core props) |
| `@eevenkoto/vue` | `*Props` on the component |
| `@eevenkoto/astro` | `*Props` in `.astro` frontmatter (`index.d.ts` re-exports) |

Do not introduce `*Args` aliases.

## File-name conventions

| Surface | Convention | Example |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Core TS sources | camelCase | `abilityScore.ts` |
| CSS / HTML folders & files | kebab-case | `ability-score/`, `primitive-tokens.css` |
| React / Vue / Astro / Storybook components | PascalCase | `AbilityScore.tsx`, `AbilityScore.astro` |
| BEM blocks | `eevenkoto-<block>` | `eevenkoto-ability-score` |
| camelCase props → BEM modifiers | kebab-case | `saveProficient` → `--save-proficient`, `runIn` → `--run-in` |

Public CSS import paths stay flat (`@eevenkoto/css/ability-score.css`) even when source lives under `core/` or `domain/`.

## Migration (0.1.x)

| Was | Use instead |
| --- | --- |
| `StatblockProps.traits` | `details` |
| HTML `*Args` (e.g. `ButtonArgs`) | `*Props` |
| Bare `StatblockFeature` / `StatblockSection` type aliases | `StatblockFeatureProps` / `StatblockSectionProps` |
| `primitivetokens.css` (legacy filename) | `primitive-tokens.css` |
| PropertyList under `core/atoms/` | `core/molecules/` |
| AbilityScoreGroup under `domain/molecules/` | `domain/organisms/` |

## Content license, readiness and gating (0.12)

| Term | Meaning | Prop / type |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **ContentLicense** | Which legal mode a text is read under | `'proprietary' \| 'open'` (never product names such as `teksti` / `srd`) |
| **LicenseBar** | Strip that shows the active license and legal links | `LicenseBarProps` (`activeLicense`, `placement`, `entries`) |
| **readiness** | Maturity of content (ready / preview / draft) | `readinessLabel` + `readinessIntent: BadgeIntent` |
| **ContentGate** | Page that explains why a document is locked | `ContentGateProps` (`currentTierLabel`, `requiredTierLabel`, `statusMessage`) |
| **tier** | A membership level | `*TierLabel`; `TierCard` for comparison |
| **checklist** | List variant with included / accent / excluded items | `List variant="checklist"`, `ListItemProps.status` |
| **details** | NPC / statblock footer PropertyList (never `traits`) | `NpcCardProps.details` |
| **svgHtml** | Trusted inline SVG for a map | `MapFrameProps.svgHtml` |

`*Html` props (`bodyHtml`, `descriptionHtml`, `captionHtml`, `nameHtml`, `valueHtml`) always accept pre-rendered inline/block HTML alongside plain strings and framework slots.
## Authoring composed components

_Source: `apps/storybook/src/foundations/authoring-composed-components.mdx`_

# Authoring composed components

Patterns learned while porting the Statblock stack (Property → Stat → AbilityScore → Statblock). Use this when adding **Domain organisms** that compose Core atoms and molecules — not when tweaking a single Core control like Button.

Also read: [Glossary](/?path=/docs/foundations-glossary--docs) · [Component taxonomy](/?path=/docs/foundations-component-taxonomy--docs) · [Packages](/?path=/docs/foundations-packages--docs) · [Minimum-class defaults](/?path=/docs/foundations-minimum-class-defaults--docs) · [Color Tokens — Architecture](/?path=/docs/foundations-color-tokens-architecture--docs) · [Tier 3 — Component Scoping](/?path=/docs/foundations-color-tokens-tier-3-component-scoping--docs)

## 1. Decide scope and hierarchy before the CSS

Place each piece on **Core vs Domain**, then map **atom → molecule → organism**. Keep English APIs; leave **product-language strings as data**. Canonical prop names (`details` vs features, `label` vs `text` vs `name`) are in the [Glossary](/?path=/docs/foundations-glossary--docs).

| Scope | Layer | Statblock example | Owns |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Core | Atom | Property, Stat, Heading, Frame, Scroll, TableCell | One semantic unit + BEM classes |
| Core | Molecule | PropertyList, Table | Layout of atoms + local ARIA |
| Core | Organism | TableShell, Workshop, TierCard, AccountMenu | Slots composing Core atoms and molecules |
| Domain | Molecule | AbilityScore, StatblockFeature, NpcCard, ReadAloudBox | Layout of Core atoms + local ARIA |
| Domain | Organism | AbilityScoreGroup, Statblock, Spellblock, EquipmentBlock, ContentGate | Page-shaped composition, slots, outline |

**Do:** Ship a working Domain organism against a real specimen (e.g. Aatelinen), then extract molecules once the seams are obvious.

**Don’t:** Invent Heading/Paragraph “product variants” for organism chrome. Visual remaps belong on the **molecule/organism host** (section looks like meso H3; feature run-in looks like micro H6) while **element levels stay honest**. Domain must not leak into Core source folders.

## 2. Keep the accessibility tree honest

| Rule | Why it mattered |
| --- | --- |
| Contiguous heading outline | Legacy H1 → H3 → H6 looked fine visually and broke structure. Prefer H1 → H2 → H3; remap *look* in CSS on the host. |
| Real landmarks and lists | `article` / `section`, real `dl` / `dt` / `dd` for definitional metadata. Use the Core **Table** ecosystem (`TableCell` → `Table` → `TableShell`) for true tabular charts — not bold-label paragraphs. |
| Name the group | Prefer `figure` / `figcaption` for a named unit; still wire `id` + `aria-labelledby` on the inner `dl` when the caption alone does not name the list. |
| Decorative punctuation in CSS | Colons and run-in periods via `::after`, not baked into copy strings. |
| Embed-safe outline props | Hardcoding H1 is correct for a dedicated entry page and wrong under a docs chrome H1. Expose `nameLevel?: 1 \| 2 \| 3` (or `titleLevel`) when the organism owns a title, and cascade child section/feature heading levels automatically. |

Screen-reader-only text belongs on a shared utility (`.eevenkoto-visually-hidden` with `clip-path: inset(50%)`), not ad-hoc `clip: rect(...)`.

## 3. Emphasis is never color alone

Status and proficiency cues must survive CVD, low vision, and **forced colors**.

1. **Redundant channel** — thicker stroke, outline, pattern, or visible mark *plus* an AT-facing term (`Save (proficient)`).
2. **Measure contrast on the real surface** — gold that passes on `surface-raised` / canvas can fail **1.4.11 (3:1)** on `surface-sunken`. Audit the panel the chip actually sits on.
3. **Prefer a new Tier 1 stop** when chrome needs a darker/lighter pigment (`gold-primary-deep`) — do not invent brand accents with hue×hue `color-mix` in Tier 2 ([Tier 1 — Prefer a new primitive](/?path=/docs/foundations-color-tokens-tier-1-primitives--docs)).
4. **Forced-colors** — strip decorative shadows; map borders to system colors (`ButtonText`, `Highlight` for emphasis). Interactive Tier 3 already requires explicit borders; content chips need the same habit.

## 4. Package checklist (every new piece)

Follow the same seam as Button / Badge / Statblock:

1. **`@eevenkoto/core`** — props + `*ClassNames()` (no DOM).
2. **`@eevenkoto/css`** — Tier 3 file; private `--_eevenkoto-*` bridges; public `--eevenkoto-<component>-*` overrides only.
3. **`@eevenkoto/html`** — canonical `render*` + template (Storybook source of truth).
4. **`@eevenkoto/react` / `@eevenkoto/vue` / `@eevenkoto/astro`** — thin wrappers; prefer `ReactNode` / slots for rich text, with opt-in `*Html` props (`bodyHtml`, `descriptionHtml`, `valueHtml`, `nameHtml`, …) for pre-rendered Markdown/rehype pipelines.
5. **Storybook** — specimen story from real product copy + MDX with **Why to use** (problem / motivation) before **When to use** (situations + Do/Don’t), plus outline, a11y, and framework notes.

HTML string → DOM is a **trust boundary**. Plain string props (`name`, `description`, `value`) are escaped; inline `*Html` props in `@eevenkoto/html` run through `sanitizeInlineHtml` (allowlisting `em`, `strong`, `i`, `b`, `br`, safe `<a href>` / `<span class>` / `data-*`, and `.eevenkoto-icon` SVGs while stripping `javascript:` URLs and event handlers).

## 5. Quick pre-merge checklist

- [ ] Heading levels match the document role; visuals remapped on the host, not via fake levels
- [ ] Lists / labels / values are programmatically associated (`dl`, `aria-labelledby`, etc.)
- [ ] Status/emphasis has a non-color cue + AT text where needed
- [ ] Non-text contrast checked on **sunken and raised** backgrounds the component uses
- [ ] `forced-colors` and `prefers-reduced-motion` considered
- [ ] Organism titles that might embed under another H1 have an escape hatch (`nameLevel` / `titleLevel`)
- [ ] Plain string props are escaped; `*Html` props stay explicit opt-ins for trusted / sanitized pipeline output
- [ ] Public API is English; locale strings stay in story / product data
- [ ] Docs: **Why to use** explains the problem; **When to use** covers situations (do not put “Use X when…” only under Why)

## Reference specimen

[Statblock — Aatelinen](/?path=/docs/domain-organisms-statblock--docs) is the worked example: Core atoms (Property, Stat), Domain molecules (AbilityScore, StatblockFeature), Domain organisms (AbilityScoreGroup, Statblock), honest outline with visual remaps, proficiency emphasis, and embed `nameLevel`.

[Spellblock — Aavevalo](/?path=/docs/domain-organisms-spellblock--docs) is the second specimen, and shows two things Statblock does not: an organism that **owns its own card surface** (banded Tier 3 chrome instead of a flat stack), and a density variant driven by `container-type: inline-size` plus explicit wrapping rules for long Finnish compounds.
## Minimum-class defaults

_Source: `apps/storybook/src/foundations/minimum-class-defaults.mdx`_

# Minimum-class defaults

Every Tier 3 **host** (`.eevenkoto-<component>`) must look and behave as the **documented default** with no modifier classes. Modifiers are only for departing from that default. Framework `*ClassNames()` helpers may still emit explicit default aliases (`--primary`, `--md`, …) for a stable prop API.

Also read: [Tier 3 — Component Scoping](/?path=/docs/foundations-color-tokens-tier-3-component-scoping--docs) · [Typography](/?path=/docs/foundations-typography--docs) · [Packages](/?path=/docs/foundations-packages--docs) · [AGENTS.md](/AGENTS.md)

## Rules for authors

1. **Host = default.** Put the full default recipe (colors, size, interactive states, elevation) on `.eevenkoto-<block>`, via private-bridge fallbacks and host-level state selectors where needed.
2. **Modifiers are opt-in.** `--secondary`, `--sm`, `--solid`, etc. only change what is not already the default.
3. **Default modifier classes are aliases.** `--primary`, `--md`, `--subtle`, `--text`, `--stripe-row` may exist for helpers/docs but must not be *required* for the default look.
4. **Tag inference (type only).** Heading levels may come from `:where(hN).eevenkoto-heading` (zero tag specificity so `--M` still overrides). Do not use bare global `h1` / `p` / `button` selectors.
5. **Prose vs Flow.** Bare `h1`–`h6` / `p` / `ul` / `ol` / `li` / `hr` / `blockquote` / `dl` / `a` get type styles only under `.eevenkoto-prose` (with `:not([class^="eevenkoto-"], [class*=" eevenkoto-"])` so nested DS components never bleed). Vertical rhythm stays on `.eevenkoto-flow`. Compose: `eevenkoto-prose eevenkoto-flow`.
6. **Helpers may still be explicit.** Core can emit default modifiers so Button / Paragraph / List / Badge size props stay aligned; CSS must not depend on those classes for the default.

## Checklist when adding or changing a component

- [ ] `.eevenkoto-<block>` alone matches the Storybook default canvas
- [ ] Hover / focus / active / disabled for the default variant work without the default variant class
- [ ] Non-default variants fully override host defaults (no leaked primary hover, etc.)
- [ ] Docs show minimum markup (`class="eevenkoto-button"`, not only the fully expanded class list)
- [ ] If introducing “none” / opt-out (e.g. table stripe), emit an explicit modifier (`--stripe-none`) rather than relying on absence of a required default class

## Current defaults (hand-authored minimum)

| Host | Minimum markup | Default meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Heading | `<h2 class="eevenkoto-heading">` | Level from tag (`:where(hN)`); `--M` overrides |
| Paragraph | `<p class="eevenkoto-paragraph">` | `body-md` + primary |
| List | `<ul class="eevenkoto-list">` + bare `li` | unordered + `body-md` + primary (`ol` / `--ordered` for decimal); items via direct-child `> :where(li)` |
| Button | `<button class="eevenkoto-button">` | primary + md (full states) |
| LinkButton | `<a class="eevenkoto-link-button" href="…">` | primary + md + end-scoop (forward CTA link) |
| Badge | `<span class="eevenkoto-badge">` | subtle + neutral + md + pill |
| Stat | `<span class="eevenkoto-stat">` | disk + md (`4rem`, `radius-full`) |
| StatusDot | `<span class="eevenkoto-status-dot">` | neutral pip |
| Chip | `<button class="eevenkoto-chip">` | unselected + md |
| CatalogTile | `<a class="eevenkoto-catalog-tile" href="…">` | raised hairline row |
| Menu | `<nav class="eevenkoto-menu">` + `ul` / `li` / `a` | raised scooped plaque + md; end-scoop rows from descendant `a` / `button` / `summary`; current page via `aria-current="page"` (`--embedded` flush sidebar) |
| Card | `<article class="eevenkoto-card">` + `header` / `p` / `footer` | flat raised surface; title look remapped on `header`; `--elevated` / `--interactive` opt-in |
| Badge intent | `eevenkoto-badge eevenkoto-badge--success` | subtle + that intent |
| Badge surface | `eevenkoto-badge eevenkoto-badge--solid` | solid + neutral |
| Table | `<table class="eevenkoto-table">` + bare `tr` / `th` / `td` | default variant + row stripe; cells from host descendants (kinds via `--index` / `--numeric`) |
| TableCell | `<td class="eevenkoto-table-cell">` | text kind — for cells outside a Table host |
| Image | `<figure class="eevenkoto-image">` | full paragraph-wide block (`--float-left` / `--float-right` opt-in) |
| Prose | `<div class="eevenkoto-prose">` + bare `h*` / `p` / `ul` / `ol` / `li` / `hr` / `blockquote` / `dl` / `a` | same defaults as classed type + Tier 2 `link-*` (excludes nested `eevenkoto-*` classes) |
| Flow | Compose with Prose for bare-tag pair gaps | classed primitives and boxed blocks via `margin-block-start` |

## CSS patterns

### Host carries default tokens and states

```css
.eevenkoto-button {
  --_eevenkoto-button-text: var(
    --eevenkoto-button-text,
    var(--eevenkoto-color-control-primary-text)
  );
  /* … full primary + md fallbacks, including elevation … */
}

/* Default interactive states on the host; exclude non-default variants */
.eevenkoto-button:hover:not(.eevenkoto-button--secondary):not(.eevenkoto-button--ghost) {
  /* primary hover publics */
}

.eevenkoto-button--primary {
  /* optional explicit alias — same publics as host defaults */
}
```

### Tag maps with `:where` (Heading)

```css
/* Tag inference comes BEFORE explicit --1..--6 modifiers */
:where(h1).eevenkoto-heading,
.eevenkoto-prose :where(h1:not([class^="eevenkoto-"], [class*=" eevenkoto-"])) {
  /* level 1 publics */
}

.eevenkoto-heading--1 {
  /* explicit level 1 publics — overrides any h1..h6 tag cleanly */
}
```

`:where` keeps tag specificity at 0 and source order places `--1..--6` after tag inference, so `.eevenkoto-heading--3` wins on `h1` and `.eevenkoto-heading--1` wins on `h3`. Bare-tag rules exclude `eevenkoto-*` classes so nested DS components never inherit Prose overrides.

### Intent / variant shortcuts (Badge)

Put the **default surface** recipe on intent-only classes; higher-specificity compounds cover non-default surfaces:

```css
.eevenkoto-badge--success { /* subtle success */ }
.eevenkoto-badge--solid { /* solid neutral */ }
.eevenkoto-badge--solid.eevenkoto-badge--success { /* solid success */ }
```

## Anti-patterns

- Requiring `--primary` / `--md` / `--subtle` / `--default` for the default look
- Putting default hover only on `.eevenkoto-button--primary:hover` so host-alone buttons look dead
- Bare `h1 { … }` or `button { … }` outside Prose / host compounds
- Treating Flow as a substitute for Prose (Flow owns gaps; Prose owns bare-tag type)

## 0.12 additions

Every component added in 0.12 renders its documented default from the host class alone:

| Host | Minimum markup | Default meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Swatch | `<span class="eevenkoto-swatch" style="--eevenkoto-swatch-color: …">` | md circle |
| Divider | `<hr class="eevenkoto-divider">` (or bare `hr` in Prose) | lg spacing (`space-6`), solid |
| ProgressBar | `<div class="eevenkoto-progress-bar">` | inline, primary, hidden until `--active` |
| FloatingBanner | `<aside class="eevenkoto-floating-banner">` | bottom-center, hidden until `--open` |
| Disclosure | `<details class="eevenkoto-disclosure">` | card variant |
| TierCard | `<article class="eevenkoto-card eevenkoto-tier-card">` | neutral, not featured |
| LicenseBar | `<aside class="eevenkoto-license-bar">` | edge stripe, proprietary |
| ReadAloudBox / NpcCard / MapFrame / ContentGate | host class | documented default |

Modifier classes (`--open`, `--featured`, `--inline`, …) are opt-in.
## Decisions

_Source: `apps/storybook/src/foundations/decisions.mdx`_

# Decisions

Short ADRs for product scope. Component APIs live on each component’s docs page.

## Content DS, not a full app kit

Eevenkoto is a **TTRPG content design system** (statblocks, entity refs, ability scores) plus **portable core chrome** (Button, Field, Menu, table stack, typography). It is not a general application kit.

**Shipped:** Core atoms/molecules/organisms listed in package READMEs (including StatusDot, Swatch, Divider, Chip, ChipGroup, Toast, ProgressBar, FloatingBanner, Disclosure, TableOfContents, SectionHeader, Catalog, Menu `embedded` / `status` / `locked` / `destructive`, Input, Select, Checkbox, Radio, CheckboxGroup, RadioGroup, Stepper, SegmentedControl, TableShell, TierCard, AccountMenu, Workshop); Domain AbilityName + EntityRef (12 kinds) → AbilityScore / AbilityScoreGroup → Statblock / Spellblock / EquipmentBlock / EquipmentWorkshop + LicenseBar, DocumentHeader, ContentTable, EntityPreview, ReadAloudBox, NpcCard, NpcCardGrid, MapFrame, ContentGate.

**Theming:** Light is the default. `[data-theme="dark"]` and `[data-surface-mode="dark"]` share the same Tier 2 remaps (Storybook toolbar). Contrast theme is not implemented (`@media (forced-colors: active)` is supported across interactive and framed surfaces).

**Token-only (no component yet):** modal surface roles, destructive Button variant (`control-destructive-*` tokens exist; Menu items support `tone="destructive"`), breadcrumb-as-link tokens. Do not assume a component exists because a Tier 2 token is named.

**0.12.0 additions:** portable page chrome that is _not_ an app shell — Swatch, Divider, ProgressBar, FloatingBanner, AccountMenu, TableOfContents, SectionHeader, Disclosure, ChipGroup, TierCard; Domain LicenseBar, DocumentHeader, ContentGate, ContentTable, EntityPreview, ReadAloudBox, NpcCard, NpcCardGrid, MapFrame. Existing components gained props (see CHANGELOG). Patterns that are only layout glue over these parts (status banner, readiness legend grid, adventure meta card, version-comparison preview) stay [composition recipes](/?path=/docs/foundations-composition-recipes--docs), not components.

**Not in scope:** Dialog, Pager, Tabs, date pickers, **AppShell / Sidebar** (collapsible rail, drawer, scroll lock, history handling — host-app behavior; compose the shipped parts inside your own shell). Popover is CSS chrome; the host app owns focus trapping and dialog behavior. Toast is a pure presentation atom (`.eevenkoto-toast`, accessible `status`/`alert` role, placement, and transitions); full runtime queueing and portal management remain the host app's domain. Compose class pages with the [Class entry recipe](/?path=/docs/foundations-class-entry-recipe--docs) — no Classblock organism yet.

## Vertical rhythm & leaf-only `text-box-trim`

Global `text-box: trim-both` on `*` was removed and banned by Stylelint (`eevenkoto/no-global-text-box-trim`): trimming block-edge half-leading while wrapped lines keep full leading inverts proximity and clips Finnish uppercase diacritics (`Ä`/`Ö`) at scrollport edges. `text-box-trim` is restricted to single-line leaf controls (`Button`, `LinkButton`). Multi-line headings (`H1`–`H3`), `Notice` titles, and `TableOfContents` links pair `--eevenkoto-line-height-snug` (`1.25`) with outer `margin-block-start` / `gap` rhythm (`Flow`, `Field`), and `.eevenkoto-prose` bare-tag selectors exclude `[class^="eevenkoto-"], [class*=" eevenkoto-"]` so nested DS components never inherit editorial tag overrides.

## Optional CSS peer

`@eevenkoto/html`, `@eevenkoto/react`, `@eevenkoto/vue`, and `@eevenkoto/astro` list `@eevenkoto/css` as an **optional** peer so markup can be assembled without styles. Appearance requires explicit CSS imports (`styles.css` + each component sheet).

## Google Fonts

Base `styles.css` imports Inter and Outfit from Google Fonts. Consumers who cannot use that CDN should override `font-family` on `:root` / `body` or self-host.

## Print is a media restyle, not a second view

Content pages keep their screen markup. `@media print` on existing hosts (outermost [Prose](/?path=/docs/core-molecules-prose--docs), Heading, Table, TableShell, Statblock, Spellblock, EquipmentBlock, AbilityScoreGroup, Card, TierCard, CatalogTile, Notice, Disclosure, ReadAloudBox, NpcCard, MapFrame, Image, InlineRef, Scroll, Workshop, plus `display: none` on Menu, AccountMenu, TableOfContents, Popover, TooltipCard, ProgressBar, FloatingBanner, edge LicenseBar) turns a long article into two snaking columns. No print-specific BEM, no `/print` route. Nested Prose sections must not open a second column context. Details: [Print columns](/?path=/docs/foundations-print-columns--docs).
## Print columns

_Source: `apps/storybook/src/foundations/print-columns.mdx`_

# Print columns

**Related:** [Prose](/?path=/docs/core-molecules-prose--docs) · [Flow](/?path=/docs/core-molecules-flow--docs) · [Decisions](/?path=/docs/foundations-decisions--docs) · [Heading](/?path=/docs/core-atoms-heading--docs)

Long-form Eevenkoto pages stay **one column on screen**. Printing the **same document** (Ctrl+P / Save as PDF) restyles outermost Prose into two snaking columns. There is no print route, no `eevenkoto-print-*` class, and no extra markup.

The live pattern is eevenko.to class pages: `article.eevenkoto-prose.eevenkoto-flow` wrapping nested `section.eevenkoto-prose.eevenkoto-flow`, bare `h1`–`h4`, TableShell, Notice, and EntityRef.

Print **this canvas** in Chrome and Firefox (the story iframe, not the Storybook manager). On screen the article must stay a single column with the lab sidebar visible.

## Architecture

Print is a restyle of existing hosts:

| Host | Print default |
| --- | --- |
| Outermost `.eevenkoto-prose` | `columns: 2`, `column-gap: space-8`, `column-fill: auto` |
| Nested `.eevenkoto-prose` | No columns (would nest fragmentainers) |
| Direct child `h1` / `h2` of Prose | `column-span: all` (excludes nested `eevenkoto-*` blocks; already `break-after: avoid`) |
| Statblock, Spellblock, EquipmentBlock, Card, TierCard, CatalogTile, Notice, Disclosure, ReadAloudBox, NpcCard, MapFrame, Image | `break-inside: avoid` |
| Table | `thead` repeats (`table-header-group`); `tbody > tr` `break-inside: avoid` |
| TableShell, AbilityScoreGroup | `column-span: all` + `break-inside: avoid` (sticky index cells reset to `position: static`) |
| Scroll, MapFrame viewport | `overflow: visible` |
| Workshop | Sticky columns reset to `position: static`; inline / non-sticky preview avoids breaks |
| InlineRef / EntityRef | Chip fill/border/underline cleared to plain inline text; `.eevenkoto-inline-ref__lock` hidden |
| Swatch | `print-color-adjust: exact` |
| Menu, AccountMenu, TableOfContents, Popover, TooltipCard, ProgressBar, FloatingBanner, edge LicenseBar (`--inline` stays visible), DocumentHeader license toggle, ContentGate actions/footer | `display: none` |
| `@page` (in `styles.css`) | A4, 18mm margin; transparent `html, body` with `print-color-adjust: exact` |

Headings **inside** Statblock or Spellblock do not span: that would pull the title out of the card.

## Tall boxed organisms

One default, no author-facing print switch: **keep the box intact** (`break-inside: avoid`). If a Statblock is taller than the remaining column, the engine leaves a hole and moves the whole card. That is the handout-grade tradeoff. Do not add `--span` or `--allow-break` modifiers.

AbilityScoreGroup and class tables span both columns so a six-wide grid is not crushed to ~90mm.

## Nested Prose (required)

```css
@media print {
  .eevenkoto-prose:not(.eevenkoto-prose .eevenkoto-prose) {
    columns: 2;
  }
}
```

Applying `columns` to every Prose host would columnize each `section.doc-section` separately.

## App chrome vs DS chrome

`.layout-shell` / `.content-wrapper` belong to the site. Menu hiding stops a 139-item nav dump. Ambient glow, login, and side ribbons stay the host app’s print sheet.

## What browsers will not do

Handout-grade, not a typesetter. Fragile: last-page `column-fill: auto`, `orphans` / `widows`, `box-decoration-break: clone` on split cards. Missing: footnotes, running heads from the current heading, “see page N”. Those need a paged-media engine (Prince, WeasyPrint, Paged.js), which is out of scope.

CSS Grid cannot snake a single prose stream. Do not print the article as two independent tracks.

## Verify

1. Screen: single column; nested sections; sidebar Menu visible.
2. Chrome Print / Save as PDF: two columns, H1/H2 span, table unclipped and full width, Menu gone, EntityRefs in-flow (no tooltip cards), short Statblock unsplit.
3. Firefox Print: same checks; note last-page fill if columns look balanced instead of newspaper-filled.

**Observed (Chromium print media, A4-width canvas):** outermost Prose `column-count: 2` / `column-fill: auto`; nested section Prose stays `column-count: auto`; H1 `column-span: all`; TableShell and AbilityScoreGroup span; Scroll `overflow: visible`; Menu `display: none`; Statblock `break-inside: avoid`. Firefox Print was not run in this lab (agent browser is Chromium only).
## Class entry recipe

_Source: `apps/storybook/src/foundations/class-entry-recipe.mdx`_

# Class entry recipe

How to compose a **player class page** (Hurjapää and siblings) from shipped pieces. There is **no Classblock organism**. If this recipe is too easy to get wrong in product markup, consider a Domain organism later — do not invent Domain Heading variants.

Also read: [PropertyList](/?path=/docs/core-molecules-propertylist--docs) · [TableShell](/?path=/docs/core-organisms-tableshell--docs) · [StatblockFeature](/?path=/docs/domain-molecules-statblockfeature--docs) · [Prose](/?path=/docs/core-molecules-prose--docs) · [Spellblock](/?path=/docs/domain-organisms-spellblock--docs)

## Why to use

Class pages mix definitional stats, a level chart, and named features. Products that paint those as unlabeled paragraphs plus one-off CSS fight the Statblock/Spellblock stack. This recipe is the documented composition so eevenko.to can delete page-local class chrome.

## When to use

Use this recipe for class, background, species, or culture **entries**. Use [Spellblock](/?path=/docs/domain-organisms-spellblock--docs) for spells and [Statblock](/?path=/docs/domain-organisms-statblock--docs) for creatures. Use Catalog for indexes of those entries.

## Outline

Keep heading levels honest (H1 name → H2 sections → H3 features). Remap look on [Heading](/?path=/docs/core-atoms-heading--docs) `runIn` for feature names, not by skipping tags.

1. **Name** — page H1 via [DocumentHeader](/?path=/docs/domain-molecules-documentheader--docs) (or Prose / Heading + optional readiness [Badge](/?path=/docs/core-atoms-badge--docs) in the page header, never inside the H1).
2. **Core (ydin)** — [PropertyList](/?path=/docs/core-molecules-propertylist--docs) for hit dice, proficiencies, typical abilities. Do not dump unlabeled bold-lead paragraphs.
3. **Level chart** — [Table](/?path=/docs/core-molecules-table--docs) inside [TableShell](/?path=/docs/core-organisms-tableshell--docs). Feature names in cells are [EntityRef](/?path=/docs/domain-atoms-entityref--docs) `classFeature`.
4. **Features** — one [StatblockFeature](/?path=/docs/domain-molecules-statblockfeature--docs) per named feature (run-in name + description). Subclass / manifest groups are [StatblockSection](/?path=/docs/domain-molecules-statblocksection--docs) titles (H2) wrapping features (H3).
5. Wrap the article in **Prose + Flow**.

## Do / Don’t

- Do keep locale strings as data (Finnish names in the app).
- Do use EntityRef `kind: 'class'` for the class name and `classFeature` for Hurma / Tyyli ja asenne.
- Don’t invent a Classblock until this recipe fails in real pages.
- Don’t restyle Heading in Domain CSS for “class chrome.”

## Migration (eevenko.to)

Hurjapää today: prose dumps for “Hurjapään ydin” + a table + h3 features. Replace the ydin block with PropertyList; keep TableShell; map each feature heading + following paragraphs to StatblockFeature.
## Composition recipes

_Source: `apps/storybook/src/foundations/composition-recipes.mdx`_

# Composition recipes

Patterns the design system deliberately does **not** ship as components. Each is layout glue over parts that already exist; a dedicated component would add API surface without adding behavior. Copy the recipe, keep the classes, change the data.

All recipes use `@eevenkoto/html` for brevity. React, Vue and Astro take the same props and slots — see [Packages](/?path=/docs/foundations-packages--docs).

## Account status banner

A signed-in greeting with a tier badge on the start side and one or two actions on the end side. Use `Card` with `layout="split"`: the main content stays on the inline-start side, `actions` on the inline-end side, and the card stacks on narrow containers.

```ts
import '@eevenkoto/css/card.css';
import '@eevenkoto/css/badge.css';
import '@eevenkoto/css/link-button.css';
import { renderCard, renderBadge, renderLinkButton } from '@eevenkoto/html';

renderCard({
  layout: 'split',
  elevated: true,
  titleHtml: 'Hei, <span class="user-name">Seikkailija</span>',
  titleLevel: 3,
  headerActions: renderBadge({ label: 'Kannattaja', intent: 'info', shape: 'pill' }),
  body: 'Tilauksesi on voimassa. Ennakkoversiot ovat avoinna.',
  actions: renderLinkButton({ href: '/tili', label: 'Hallitse tiliä', variant: 'secondary' }),
});
```

`titleHtml` accepts a hydration target (`<span class="user-name">`) for client-side personalisation.

## Readiness legend grid

An overview of readiness levels (what "ready", "preview" and "draft" mean). Use a sunken `Card` with a `StatusDot` + label per tile, laid out by your own CSS grid.

```ts
import '@eevenkoto/css/card.css';
import '@eevenkoto/css/status-dot.css';
import { renderCard, renderStatusDot } from '@eevenkoto/html';

const tile = (intent, label, text) =>
  renderCard({
    surface: 'sunken',
    title: label,
    titleLevel: 3,
    headerActions: renderStatusDot({ intent, label }),
    body: text,
  });

`<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(16rem,1fr));gap:var(--eevenkoto-space-3)">
  ${tile('success', 'Valmis', 'Lopullinen sisältö.')}
  ${tile('caution', 'Ennakko', 'Voi muuttua.')}
  ${tile('neutral', 'Luonnos', 'Keskeneräinen.')}
</div>`;
```

The grid wrapper is app layout. Keep gaps on `--eevenkoto-space-*` tokens.

## Adventure meta card

Key facts about an adventure (level range, length, players, system). Use `Card` with `accent="top"` and a four-column `PropertyList`.

```ts
import '@eevenkoto/css/card.css';
import '@eevenkoto/css/property.css';
import { renderCard, renderPropertyList } from '@eevenkoto/html';

renderCard({
  accent: 'top',
  surface: 'subtle',
  title: 'Seikkailun tiedot',
  titleLevel: 2,
  bodyHtml: renderPropertyList({
    layout: 'grid',
    columns: 4,
    items: [
      { label: 'Taso', value: '3–5' },
      { label: 'Kesto', value: '4 h' },
      { label: 'Pelaajat', value: '3–5' },
      { label: 'Järjestelmä', value: 'Eevenkoto' },
    ],
  }),
});
```

Use `layout="cards"` with `PropertyItem.meta` for highlight tiles (value + secondary lines), and `Card accent="start"` for a single highlighted attribute box.

## Highlight tile / attribute box

A single emphasised fact with supporting lines.

```ts
import '@eevenkoto/css/card.css';
import '@eevenkoto/css/property.css';
import { renderCard, renderPropertyList } from '@eevenkoto/html';

renderCard({
  accent: 'start',
  surface: 'subtle',
  bodyHtml: renderPropertyList({
    layout: 'cards',
    columns: 2,
    items: [{ label: 'Kesto', value: '3 / 4', meta: ['Murskaus 4', 'Viilto 3'] }],
  }),
});
```

## Version comparison preview

Side-by-side reading modes (proprietary text vs. open SRD text). Use a `SegmentedControl` (links or radios mode) to pick the mode and sunken `Card` panels for each version; the host app swaps visibility. Reflect the active mode with `[data-content-license="open"]` on an ancestor so `DocumentHeader` headings follow, and with [`LicenseBar`](/?path=/docs/domain-molecules-licensebar--docs).

```ts
import '@eevenkoto/css/segmented-control.css';
import '@eevenkoto/css/card.css';
import { renderSegmentedControl, renderCard } from '@eevenkoto/html';

`<div data-content-license="open">
  ${renderSegmentedControl({
    label: 'Lukutila',
    mode: 'radios',
    name: 'mode',
    selectedId: 'open',
    options: [
      { id: 'proprietary', label: 'Teksti' },
      { id: 'open', label: 'SRD' },
    ],
  })}
  ${renderCard({ surface: 'sunken', title: 'SRD', body: 'Avoin teksti (CC-BY 4.0).' })}
</div>`;
```

## Categorised swatch picker tray

A colour picker grouped by category (skin, hair, cloth). Compose `Disclosure` (one per category) with a `ChipGroup` of `swatchColor` options. Selection state and persistence belong to the app; the DS provides the markup (`data-value`, `aria-pressed`) and opaque disabled styling.

```ts
import '@eevenkoto/css/disclosure.css';
import '@eevenkoto/css/chip-group.css';
import { renderDisclosure, renderChipGroup } from '@eevenkoto/html';

renderDisclosure({
  label: 'Hiukset',
  variant: 'subtle',
  open: true,
  bodyHtml: renderChipGroup({
    label: 'Hiusten väri',
    hideLegend: true,
    mode: 'single',
    options: [
      { value: 'dark', label: 'Tumma', selected: true, swatchColor: '#2b1d14' },
      { value: 'fair', label: 'Vaalea', swatchColor: '#e6c88b' },
    ],
  }),
});
```

Use `Disclosure` `summaryLead` for a leading `Swatch` and `summaryMeta` for a count or current value.

## Inline generator (formerly "GeneratorCard")

Use `Workshop` with `layout="inline"` — no separate component. `icon`, `title`, `subtitle` build the header, `toolbar` sits above the preview, and `footer` holds quick picks. Toolbars are `Workshop`'s `toolbar` prop, not a separate molecule.

## Application shell

Not a recipe, by design: see [Decisions](/?path=/docs/foundations-decisions--docs). Place `ProgressBar` (fixed), `FloatingBanner`, `AccountMenu`, `TableOfContents` and `LicenseBar` inside your own shell; z-order comes from the `--eevenkoto-z-*` tokens and the drawer scrim from `--eevenkoto-color-depth-scrim`.

# Component index

Short Why/When plus the first API table from each Storybook MDX. Full docs stay in Storybook.

### Avatar

_Source: `apps/storybook/src/core/atoms/Avatar/Avatar.mdx` · [Storybook](/?path=/docs/core-atoms-avatar--docs)_

**Why:** Rules and roster UIs need a compact face mark for a character or account without inventing ad-hoc circles. Avatar is that portrait shell — image or quiet parchment placeholder — sized on the shared sm/md/lg ladder.

**When:** **Do:** Pass `src` when you have a portrait asset. Omit `src` for the parchment user placeholder until an image exists. Always provide `name` for `alt` / `aria-label`. **Don't:** Don’t encode online status or role on the avatar — use Badge or text nearby. Don’t invent initials or turquoise fills; the placeholder is the user icon on parchment. Don’t use Avatar as a Button — wrap a control if the portrait is interactive.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `string` | — | Accessible name. |
| `src` | `string` | — | Portrait URL; omit for placeholder. |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `md` | Diameter ladder. |

### Badge

_Source: `apps/storybook/src/core/atoms/Badge/Badge.mdx` · [Storybook](/?path=/docs/core-atoms-badge--docs)_

**Why:** Status and taxonomy need a compact, scannable marker beside content — readiness, severity, membership — without looking like a click target. Badge is that non-interactive chip so metadata stays visible without competing with Buttons or filters.

**When:** **Do:** Status indicators with optional `dot` (readiness, validation state). Non-interactive entity or role tags beside headings or rows. Map product labels in the app (*Ready*, *Draft*) → DS `intent`; keep copy in the product. **Don't:** Don’t use Badge as a clickable filter — that is [Chip](/?path=/docs/core-atoms-chip--docs). Don’t use Badge without a visible label in a nav tree — that is [StatusDot](/?path=/docs/core-atoms-statusdot--docs). Don’t invent local OKLCH in the component; finalize placeholder Tier 1 hues, then adjust Tier 2 mixes. Don’t put product-specific presets (*Guest*, *Spell*) into `@eevenkoto/core`. Don’t use ALL CAPS — sentence case + bold (P5).

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` | — | Visible text (sentence case). |
| `variant` | `'subtle' \| 'solid' \| 'outline'` | `'subtle'` | Surface recipe. |
| `intent` | `'neutral' \| 'info' \| 'success' \| 'caution' \| 'critical' \| 'admin'` | `'neutral'` | Feedback intent. |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `'md'` | Shared size ladder. |
| `shape` | `'pill' \| 'rounded'` | `'pill'` | Corner treatment. |
| `dot` | `boolean` | `false` | Status dot (`__dot`). |

### Button

_Source: `apps/storybook/src/core/atoms/Button/Button.mdx` · [Storybook](/?path=/docs/core-atoms-button--docs)_

**Why:** Buttons execute actions in the interface: submitting a form, opening a dialog, cancelling an operation, or performing add/remove actions. They stand out from surrounding content and guide attention to the most important actions.

**When:** Use a Button when the user needs to perform an explicit action — initiating a task, submitting information, confirming a decision, or opening additional functionality. Prefer a Button whenever the user is expected to *do* something, not only navigate or view content.

| Arg / concern | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `'primary' \| 'secondary' \| 'ghost'` | No | `'primary'` | Maps to `eevenkoto-button--{variant}`. Host alone is also primary in CSS. |
| `label` | `string` | Yes | — | Visible text; also `aria-label` when `iconPosition` is `only`. |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | No | `'md'` | Maps to `eevenkoto-button--sm` / `--md` / `--lg`. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | No | `false` | Sets the native `disabled` attribute. |
| `icon` | `ButtonIconName` | No | — | From token `BUTTON_ICON_NAMES` (renders Icon). |
| `iconPosition` | `'left' \| 'right' \| 'only'` | No | `'left'` when icon is set | Maps to `eevenkoto-button--icon-*`. |
| `fullWidth` | `boolean` | No | `false` | Stretches the button to `inline-size: 100%` (`eevenkoto-button--full-width`). |

### Caption

_Source: `apps/storybook/src/core/atoms/Caption/Caption.mdx` · [Storybook](/?path=/docs/core-atoms-caption--docs)_

**Why:** Captions keep timestamps, helper hints, and field metadata visually quieter than body copy — smaller type and tertiary ink — without inventing a one-off rem or gray.

**When:** Use Caption under form fields, on cards, or beside status metadata. Prefer Paragraph for multi-sentence prose and Heading for titles.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | `string` | — | Supporting or metadata copy (Astro also accepts the default slot). |
| `tone` | `'secondary' \| 'primary' \| 'accent'` | `'secondary'` | Ink role (`secondary` maps to `content-tertiary`). |
| `variant` | `'default' \| 'eyebrow'` | `'default'` | Sentence-case metadata or tracked uppercase kicker (`--eyebrow`). |
| `id` | `string` | — | Host element `id` (React, Vue, and Astro HTML attributes). |

### Checkbox

_Source: `apps/storybook/src/core/atoms/Checkbox/Checkbox.mdx` · [Storybook](/?path=/docs/core-atoms-checkbox--docs)_

**Why:** Form controls in TTRPG toolchains (character builders, equipment customizers, feature selectors) need clear visual states for selection, multi-line descriptions, and selectable card layouts without losing native keyboard and assistive technology ergonomics.

**When:** **Do:** Use Checkbox for binary independent choices or multi-select lists. Use `variant="card"` for rich selectable panels with titles, descriptions, and price badges. Group related checkboxes with **CheckboxGroup** to provide a shared `<legend>` and validation messaging. **Don't:** Don't use Checkbox when only one option can be selected from a set — use **Radio** or **RadioGroup**. Don't replace Checkbox with non-interactive Badges or Chips for selectable state.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | — | Native `<input id>`. |
| `name` | `string` | — | Native `<input name>`. |
| `value` | `string` | — | Value submitted when checked. |
| `label` | `string` | **required** | Accessible label text. |
| `description` | `string` | — | Optional secondary descriptive text. |
| `badge` | `string` | — | Optional badge or price label on the right. |
| `checked` | `boolean` | `false` | Controlled checked state. |
| `defaultChecked` | `boolean` | — | Initial checked state when uncontrolled. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disabled interaction. |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | `false` | Invalid validation state (`aria-invalid="true"`). |
| `variant` | `'default' \| 'card'` | `'default'` | Visual display variant. |
| `card` | `boolean` | `false` | Convenience boolean alias for `variant="card"`. |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md'` | `'md'` | Sizing scale. |
| `ariaLabel` | `string` | — | `aria-label` override on the `<input>`. |
| `ariaDescribedBy` | `string` | — | `aria-describedby` id(s) on the `<input>`. |

### Chip

_Source: `apps/storybook/src/core/atoms/Chip/Chip.mdx` · [Storybook](/?path=/docs/core-atoms-chip--docs)_

**Why:** Dev role switchers and small exclusive tags need a clickable chip that is not a Badge (feedback, non-interactive) and not a full Button. Chip is that control so eevenko.to can drop `.role-chip` / `.dev-chip`.

**When:** **Do:** Toggleable filters or role presets the user can select. Use `href` when the chip navigates (still a Chip, not LinkButton). Use [Segmented Control](/?path=/docs/core-molecules-segmentedcontrol--docs) when the set is exclusive and always visible as one track (Full text ↔ SRD). **Don't:** Don’t use Chip for non-interactive readiness — that is [Badge](/?path=/docs/core-atoms-badge--docs) or [StatusDot](/?path=/docs/core-atoms-statusdot--docs). Don’t paint Chip with feedback intents; selected uses control primary. Don’t replace a hamburger or search control with Chip — that is Button icon-only.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` | — | Visible text. |
| `selected` | `boolean` | `false` | Pressed / current. |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `'md'` | Shared control ladder. |
| `icon` | `IconName` | — | Optional leading decorative glyph (`size="sm"`). |
| `swatchColor` | `string` | — | Optional leading decorative Swatch (`size="sm"`). |
| `href` | `string` | — | When set, renders as `<a>`. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Non-interactive (opaque disabled tokens). |

### Divider

_Source: `apps/storybook/src/core/atoms/Divider/Divider.mdx` · [Storybook](/?path=/docs/core-atoms-divider--docs)_

**Why:** One rule for every section break, tied to `--eevenkoto-color-boundary-subtle` and the shared space scale, with `forced-colors` support.

**When:** - Use between unrelated sections of a page or document. - Use `spacing="sm"` inside dense cards, `dashed` for softer secondary breaks. - Don't use it as a card or table border — use the host component's own border.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `spacing` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `'lg'` | Block margin (`space-3` / `space-4` / `space-6`). |
| `variant` | `'solid' \| 'dashed'` | `'solid'` | Stroke style. |

### Frame

_Source: `apps/storybook/src/core/atoms/Frame/Frame.mdx` · [Storybook](/?path=/docs/core-atoms-frame--docs)_

**Why:** Dense charts and token boards need a portable bordered panel so they read as contained rulebook surfaces instead of bleeding into the page canvas. Frame is that host — TableShell uses it by default, and other panels can reuse the same border without a one-off box.

**When:** Wrap dense charts, token panels, or any content that should read as a contained rulebook panel. Prefer bare layout when the page canvas is enough.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `content` | `string` | — | HTML package: inner HTML (`children` / default slot in React, Vue, and Astro). |
| `id` | `string` | — | Host element `id` (React, Vue, and Astro HTML attributes). |

### Heading

_Source: `apps/storybook/src/core/atoms/Heading/Heading.mdx` · [Storybook](/?path=/docs/core-atoms-heading--docs)_

**Why:** Pages need a scannable outline readers and assistive tech can trust. Heading gives six structured levels — size, weight, family, case, posture, and light rules — so titles stay consistent without faking hierarchy with bold Paragraphs or skipped levels for looks alone.

**When:** Use Heading for page titles and section labels. One `h1` per view; nest levels without skipping for style alone.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `level` | `1 \| 2 \| 3 \| 4 \| 5 \| 6` | `2` | Semantic heading level (`h1`–`h6`). |
| `text` | `string` | — | Heading copy (Astro also accepts the default slot). |
| `tone` | `'primary' \| 'secondary'` | `'primary'` | Content color tone. |
| `runIn` | `boolean` | `false` | Levels `2`–`6`: flows the heading inline into the following Paragraph. |
| `id` | `string` | — | Element `id` for anchor jumps and `aria-labelledby` (React, Vue, and Astro HTML attributes). |

### Icon

_Source: `apps/storybook/src/core/atoms/Icon/Icon.mdx` · [Storybook](/?path=/docs/core-atoms-icon--docs)_

**Why:** Chrome needs the same glyphs in Button, adornments, and product UI without each consumer pasting SVG path strings. Icon is the shared renderer (size ladder + `currentColor`); the name inventory stays in core tokens so the catalog has one source of truth.

**When:** **Do:** Pick names from the [Icons token catalog](/?path=/docs/foundations-tokens--docs#icons) — add glyphs only in `tokens/icons.ts`. Let the parent set color (`currentColor`). Omit `label` when decorative (`aria-hidden`). Use Button’s `icon` prop for `BUTTON_ICON_NAMES` (16×16 filled chrome glyphs); use Icon directly everywhere else. **Don't:** Don’t paste path strings into Button, Menu, or product CSS. Don’t grow a parallel icon map next to `iconPaths`. Don’t treat Icon as a click target — wrap Button or a link when the glyph is interactive.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `IconName` | — | From token `ICON_NAMES`. |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `'md'` | Size ladder. |
| `label` | `string` | — | Accessible name; omit when decorative. |

### Image

_Source: `apps/storybook/src/core/atoms/Image/Image.mdx` · [Storybook](/?path=/docs/core-atoms-image--docs)_

**Why:** Narrative rules and sourcebooks depend on visual rhythm to break up dense rule columns. Using bare unstyled `<img>` tags often leads to layout shifts during loading, leaking floats that ruin subsequent headings, or cramped text ribbons on narrow screens.

**When:** **Do:** Use the default host for paragraph-wide scene illustrations, maps, and diagrams. Use `layout="float-right"` or `layout="float-left"` for spot art, magic items, or creature vignettes embedded in narrative copy. Always provide a descriptive `alt` text (or an explicit empty string `alt=""` if purely decorative). Provide `width` and `height`, or `aspectRatio`, to eliminate Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS). Pair with `caption` to render an accessible `<figcaption>` formatted with Eevenkoto caption typography. Compose inside `.eevenkoto-prose.eevenkoto-flow` for automatic clearance and baseline alignment. **Don't:** Don’t use bare unstyled `<img>` tags inside content columns. Don’t use Image for user/character profile avatars — use [Avatar](/?path=/docs/core-atoms-avatar--docs). Don’t use manual CSS floats or clearfix hacks — Image handles wrapping, responsive collapse, and heading clearance automatically. Don’t force floated spot art inside narrow sidebars — Image will collapse them to block when container width is under 32rem. Don’t duplicate the caption in the `alt` text.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `src` | `string` | — | Image asset URL. |
| `alt` | `string` | — | Accessible description (empty string if decorative). |
| `caption` | `string` | — | Optional figcaption copy. |
| `layout` | `'block' \| 'float-left' \| 'float-right'` | `'block'` | Layout presentation and float wrapping mode. |
| `framed` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether to render a bordered boundary frame. |
| `width` | `number \| string` | — | Intrinsic width attribute (prevents CLS). |
| `height` | `number \| string` | — | Intrinsic height attribute (prevents CLS). |
| `aspectRatio` | `string` | — | CSS aspect ratio (e.g. `'16/9'`, `'4/3'`, `'1/1'`). |
| `fit` | `'cover' \| 'contain' \| 'fill' \| 'scale-down' \| 'none'` | `'cover'` | Object-fit mode for media. |
| `loading` | `'lazy' \| 'eager'` | `'lazy'` | Native browser loading strategy. |
| `decoding` | `'async' \| 'sync' \| 'auto'` | `'async'` | Image decoding strategy. |
| `fetchPriority` | `'high' \| 'low' \| 'auto'` | — | Priority hint for LCP scheduling. |
| `srcSet` | `string` | — | Responsive srcset attribute. |
| `sizes` | `string` | — | Responsive sizes attribute. |

### Inline Ref

_Source: `apps/storybook/src/core/atoms/InlineRef/InlineRef.mdx` · [Storybook](/?path=/docs/core-atoms-inlineref--docs)_

**Why:** Body copy often points at another page, a previewable term, a name that has no page yet, or a destination the reader cannot open. InlineRef is that mark without Button chrome, Badge status, or product vocabulary — so Core Popover triggers stay Core and eevenko.to can drop `.unlinked-term` / `.tooltip-ref-locked`.

**When:** **Do:** Mark an inline term that can open a Popover / TooltipCard preview. Prefer a real `href` when the term has a destination URL. Set `unlinked` when the term is known but has no page (italic + dotted underline, never a link). Set `locked` when the destination is gated; keep `href` if login still navigates. Override `lockedLabel` when the UI is localized (*Lukittu*). Use Domain [EntityRef](/?path=/docs/domain-atoms-entityref--docs) when you need closed rules kinds (`spell`, `condition`, `creature`, …). **Don't:** Don’t invent Domain kinds on InlineRef — that is EntityRef. Don’t use InlineRef for status or readiness — that is Badge. Don’t wrap InlineRef in a Button; the link (or tag) is the trigger. Don’t embed Lucide (or other) lock SVGs — use `locked` and the Icon token. Don’t set both `unlinked` and `href` expecting a link; unlinked always renders a `span`.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `string` | — | Visible label. |
| `href` | `string` | — | When set (and not `unlinked`), renders as `<a>`. |
| `unlinked` | `boolean` | `false` | Known term, no destination (`span` + `--unlinked`). |
| `locked` | `boolean` | `false` | Trailing lock Icon + visually hidden `lockedLabel`. |
| `lockedLabel` | `string` | `'Locked'` | Accessible lock name; override when localized. |

### Input

_Source: `apps/storybook/src/core/atoms/Input/Input.mdx` · [Storybook](/?path=/docs/core-atoms-input--docs)_

**Why:** Every product form should not invent its own text-box surface. Input owns fill, border, focus, and invalid chrome once; Field (or equivalent host markup) owns the labeling contract around it.

**When:** **Do:** Nest Input inside **Field** for forms; pass matching `id` / `describedBy` / `invalid` from the Field message. Use `ariaLabel` only when there is genuinely no visible label (chrome search). Treat `placeholder` as an example value — never as the accessible name. **Don't:** Don’t treat Input as a complete form field (no visible label + no Field). Don’t pass a visible-label string as Input `ariaLabel` when Field already has `label` — that duplicates the name. Don’t show `invalid` chrome without Field `error` text linked via `describedBy`.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | — | Wire to Field `htmlFor` / `<label for>`. |
| `name` | `string` | — | Native `<input name>` for form submission. |
| `type` | `'text' \| 'search' \| 'email' \| 'password' \| 'tel' \| 'url' \| 'number'` | `'text'` (`'search'` when `search` is true) | Native `<input type>`. |
| `value` | `string` | — | Current input value. |
| `placeholder` | `string` | — | Example hint, not the accessible name. |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md'` | `'md'` | Control height/font scale (`control-sm` / `control-md`). |
| `ariaLabel` | `string` | — | `aria-label` when **no** visible Field label. |
| `describedBy` | `string` | — | `aria-describedby` (Field message id). |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | `false` | Invalid paint + `aria-invalid`. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Sets native `disabled` and opaque disabled tokens. |
| `search` | `boolean` | `false` | Pill + leading `search` Icon recipe. |
| `icon` | `string \| ReactNode` (slot in Vue/Astro) | `search` glyph when `search` is true | Custom leading icon (`icon` prop in HTML/React; `#icon` / `slot="icon"` in Vue/Astro). |
| `fullWidth` | `boolean` | `false` | Stretches wrapper to `inline-size: 100%` (`eevenkoto-input--full-width`). |

### LinkButton

_Source: `apps/storybook/src/core/atoms/LinkButton/LinkButton.mdx` · [Storybook](/?path=/docs/core-atoms-linkbutton--docs)_

**Why:** Call-to-action navigation needs a control that *looks* like a button so it can compete with surrounding chrome, but it must remain a link: it has a destination, can be opened in a new tab, and participates in the browser’s link model. Putting `href` on Button (or wrapping Button in an anchor) mixes those roles.

**When:** Use a LinkButton when the user should **go somewhere** and that destination is a primary, secondary, or ghost action link (hero, empty state, campaign banner, quiet back-to-catalog chrome). Use [Button](/?path=/docs/core-atoms-button--docs) when the user **does** something on the page. Use [InlineRef](/?path=/docs/core-atoms-inlineref--docs) for terms inside running text.

| Arg / concern | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `href` | `string` | Yes | — | Destination URL. |
| `variant` | `'primary' \| 'secondary' \| 'ghost'` | No | `'primary'` | Maps to `eevenkoto-link-button--{variant}`. Host alone is also primary. |
| `label` | `string` | Yes | — | Visible chrome copy. |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | No | `'md'` | Maps to `--sm` / `--md` / `--lg`. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | No | `false` | Removes `href`; adds `aria-disabled` + `tabindex="-1"`. Prefer omitting. |
| `icon` | `ButtonIconName` | No | — | From `BUTTON_ICON_NAMES`. |
| `iconPosition` | `'left' \| 'right'` | No | `'right'` when icon is set | Maps to `--icon-*`. |
| `target` | `string` | No | — | Native `target`. |
| `rel` | `string` | No | — | Native `rel`; `_blank` automatically adds `noopener noreferrer`. |
| `fullWidth` | `boolean` | No | `false` | Stretches the CTA across its container (`eevenkoto-link-button--full-width`). |

### Paragraph

_Source: `apps/storybook/src/core/atoms/Paragraph/Paragraph.mdx` · [Storybook](/?path=/docs/core-atoms-paragraph--docs)_

**Why:** Consistent body type keeps reading rhythm stable across pages and themes. Semantic sizes let density or theme remaps change roles without renaming the rem ladder.

**When:** Use Paragraph for multi-sentence body copy. Prefer Heading for titles and Caption for short metadata.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | `string` | — | Body copy (Astro also accepts the default slot). |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `'md'` | Semantic body size role (`body-sm` / `body-md` / `body-lg`). |
| `tone` | `'primary' \| 'secondary'` | `'primary'` | Content color tone. |
| `id` | `string` | — | Host element `id` (React, Vue, and Astro HTML attributes). |

### Popover

_Source: `apps/storybook/src/core/atoms/Popover/Popover.mdx` · [Storybook](/?path=/docs/core-atoms-popover--docs)_

**Why:** Short-lived secondary content — entity previews, compact help, a small menu shell — needs an elevated surface next to a trigger without the weight of a dialog. Popover is that chrome; the app still owns show/hide, focus, and collision.

**When:** **Do:** Use the panel as chrome and let the **app** own show/hide, delays, Escape, and collision. Anchor preview tooltips on **InlineRef links** (Core). Use Domain [EntityRef](/?path=/docs/domain-atoms-entityref--docs) when closed kinds are required. Nest [TooltipCard](/?path=/docs/core-molecules-tooltipcard--docs) for header / body / footer inside the panel. Prefer `fixed` + portal to `body` when the trigger lives in scrolling or overflowing prose. **Don't:** Don’t assume a Button trigger — Storybook demos once used buttons for convenience only. Don’t put Floating UI / Popper inside `@eevenkoto/css`. Positioning math stays in the app (or a future optional helper package). Don’t use Popover for blocking multi-step flows — that is a dialog pattern with focus management you own carefully. Don’t double chrome: either plain content in Popover, or TooltipCard nested (it sheds its own border/shadow as a direct child).

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `placement` | `'top' \| 'top-start' \| 'top-end' \| 'bottom' \| 'bottom-start' \| 'bottom-end' \| 'left' \| 'right'` | `'bottom'` | Absolute placement. Ignored when `fixed`. |
| `arrow` | `boolean` | `false` | Renders `__arrow`. |
| `fixed` | `boolean` | `false` | Portal / JS-positioned overlay (`z-tooltip`). |
| `open` | `boolean` | `false` | Visible state for `fixed` panels. |
| `matchTriggerWidth` | `boolean` | `false` | Sets `min-inline-size: 100%` (and stretches nested Menu) in anchored mode. |
| `label` | `string` | — | `aria-label` on the panel. |
| `id` | `string` | — | Panel element `id` for `aria-controls` / `aria-describedby` (React, Vue, and Astro HTML attributes). |
| `content` | `string` | — | HTML package: panel inner HTML. |
| `role` | `'dialog' \| 'tooltip' \| 'note' \| 'group'` | — | Optional ARIA role. |

### ProgressBar

_Source: `apps/storybook/src/core/atoms/ProgressBar/ProgressBar.mdx` · [Storybook](/?path=/docs/core-atoms-progressbar--docs)_

**Why:** Shared motion, `prefers-reduced-motion` fallback (static 65% fill), forced-colors and print behavior for page-transition and upload feedback.

**When:** - Use `fixed` + `tone="accent"` or `"primary"` for page-navigation progress; toggle `active` from your router. - Use `value` for known-length work like uploads. - Don't use it for form-step position — use [Stepper](/?path=/docs/core-molecules-stepper--docs).

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | — | DOM id. |
| `active` | `boolean` | `false` | Visible; sets `aria-busy`. Otherwise `aria-hidden`. |
| `tone` | `'primary' \| 'accent'` | `'primary'` | Turquoise or gold fill. |
| `fixed` | `boolean` | `false` | Pin to viewport top. |
| `label` | `string` | `'Loading'` | Accessible name. |
| `value` | `number` | — | Determinate 0–100 (clamped). |

### Property

_Source: `apps/storybook/src/core/atoms/Property/Property.mdx` · [Storybook](/?path=/docs/core-atoms-property--docs)_

**Why:** Pair a definition term with its value without inventing a new layout. The atom keeps `dt`/`dd` semantics so assistive tech reads the association.

**When:** Use Property inside a `dl` (PropertyList) for keyed facts. Do not use it for running prose or for interactive form fields (use Field).

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` | **required** | Definition term (`<dt>`). CSS appends the colon. |
| `value` | `string` (HTML/Vue/Astro) / `ReactNode` (React) | — | Definition value (`<dd>`; Vue and Astro also accept the default slot). |
| `valueHtml` | `string` | — | Trusted pre-rendered inline HTML for `<dd>` (takes precedence over `value`). |
| `meta` | `string \| string[]` | — | Optional secondary metadata line(s) stacked inside `<dd>` (`.eevenkoto-property__meta`). |
| `id` | `string` | — | Row wrapper `<div id>` (React, Vue, and Astro HTML attributes). |

### Radio

_Source: `apps/storybook/src/core/atoms/Radio/Radio.mdx` · [Storybook](/?path=/docs/core-atoms-radio--docs)_

**Why:** Mutually exclusive choices need clear affordance, keyboard arrow navigation, and flexible presentations ranging from compact inline options to rich trait cards or selection tiles.

**When:** **Do:** Use Radio for mutually exclusive options in a list or group. Use `variant="card"` for descriptive options with secondary text and pricing. Use `variant="tile"` for compact grid-aligned options (e.g. dice steps or category tags). Group related options with **RadioGroup** to provide a shared `<legend>` and managed value state. **Don't:** Don't use Radio when multiple selections are allowed — use **Checkbox**. Don't leave a radio button without a matching `name` attribute connecting it to its set.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | — | Native `<input id>`. |
| `name` | `string` | — | Name of the radio button group (inherited when inside `RadioGroup`; provide on standalone radios). |
| `value` | `string` | **required** | Value submitted when selected. |
| `label` | `string` | **required** | Accessible visible label. |
| `description` | `string` | — | Secondary descriptive copy. |
| `badge` | `string` | — | Right-aligned badge or tag. |
| `checked` | `boolean` | `false` | Controlled checked state. |
| `defaultChecked` | `boolean` | — | Initial checked state when uncontrolled. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disabled state. |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | `false` | Invalid validation state (`aria-invalid="true"`). |
| `variant` | `'default' \| 'card' \| 'tile'` | `'default'` | Visual display variant. |
| `card` | `boolean` | `false` | Convenience boolean alias for `variant="card"`. |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md'` | `'md'` | Sizing scale. |
| `ariaLabel` | `string` | — | `aria-label` override on the `<input>`. |
| `ariaDescribedBy` | `string` | — | `aria-describedby` id(s) on the `<input>`. |

### Scroll

_Source: `apps/storybook/src/core/atoms/Scroll/Scroll.mdx` · [Storybook](/?path=/docs/core-atoms-scroll--docs)_

**Why:** Wide tables and tall panels overflow the frame. Scroll owns the overflow axis (and sticky cues when composed) so hosts like TableShell do not invent one-off `overflow` CSS per layout.

**When:** Wrap content that may exceed the viewport or frame. TableShell enables Scroll by default around Table.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `axis` | `'x' \| 'y' \| 'both'` | `'x'` | Overflow axis (`eevenkoto-scroll--x` / `--y` / `--both`). |
| `content` | `string` | — | HTML package: inner HTML (`children` / default slot in React, Vue, and Astro). |
| `id` | `string` | — | Host element `id` (React, Vue, and Astro HTML attributes). |

### Select

_Source: `apps/storybook/src/core/atoms/Select/Select.mdx` · [Storybook](/?path=/docs/core-atoms-select--docs)_

**Why:** Dropdown selection from a list of 5+ mutually exclusive choices without taking up vertical canvas space. Native `<select>` guarantees touch platform support (iOS / Android wheel pickers), keyboard typeahead, and full accessibility support out of the box.

**When:** **Do:** Use Select when space is limited and there are 5 or more options. Use grouped options (`optgroup`) to organize large option sets into categories. Wrap with **Field** for visible labels, hints, and error messaging in forms. **Don't:** Don't use Select for binary choices (Yes/No) — use **Checkbox** or **RadioGroup**. Don't use Select when options should be scannable simultaneously — use **RadioGroup** or **SegmentedControl**.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | — | Wire to Field `htmlFor` / `<label for>`. |
| `name` | `string` | — | Native `<select name>` attribute. |
| `options` | `SelectOption[]` | `[]` | Flat `<option>` items (`{ value, label, disabled? }`). |
| `groups` | `SelectOptionGroup[]` | `[]` | Categorized `<optgroup>` sets (`{ label, options }`); may be combined with `options`. |
| `value` | `string` | — | Controlled selected value. |
| `defaultValue` | `string` | — | Initial selected value when `value` is omitted. |
| `placeholder` | `string` | — | Disabled placeholder `<option value="">` for empty selection. |
| `ariaLabel` | `string` | — | `aria-label` when **no** visible Field label. |
| `describedBy` | `string` | — | `aria-describedby` (Field message id). |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disabled state (`eevenkoto-select--disabled` + native `disabled`). |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | `false` | Invalid validation state (`eevenkoto-select--invalid` + `aria-invalid="true"`). |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md'` | `'md'` | Sizing scale. |
| `fullWidth` | `boolean` | `false` | Stretches wrapper to `inline-size: 100%` (`eevenkoto-select--full-width`). |

### Stat

_Source: `apps/storybook/src/core/atoms/Stat/Stat.mdx` · [Storybook](/?path=/docs/core-atoms-stat--docs)_

**Why:** Ability math needs scannable glyphs with distinctive silhouettes. Stat encodes that geometry once so AbilityScore can compose three chips without one-off CSS per cell.

**When:** **Do:** Ability score / modifier / save glyphs. Other prominent numeric badges that are not feedback status. Compose via AbilityScore when building the standard triad. **Don't:** Don’t use Stat for readiness / severity — that is [Badge](/?path=/docs/core-atoms-badge--docs). Don’t invent local OKLCH; bridge to Tier 2 (`surface-*`, `content-accent`). Don’t hard-code `9999px` for disks — use `--eevenkoto-radius-full`.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `string` | — | Displayed number / signed modifier. |
| `shape` | `'disk' \| 'arch' \| 'shield'` | `'disk'` | Geometry. |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `'md'` | Shared size ladder. |
| `emphasis` | `boolean` | `false` | Deep accent border + thicker stroke/outline. |

### Status Dot

_Source: `apps/storybook/src/core/atoms/StatusDot/StatusDot.mdx` · [Storybook](/?path=/docs/core-atoms-statusdot--docs)_

**Why:** Tree navigation and dense catalogs need a color + shape cue for draft vs ready without a word beside every row. StatusDot is that pip so products do not hide Badge labels or invent `.nav-valmius` CSS.

**When:** **Do:** Put a pip at the **end** of a [Menu](/?path=/docs/core-molecules-menu--docs) item (`status` on the entry). Put a pip at the **start** of a [CatalogTile](/?path=/docs/core-molecules-catalog--docs). Always pass `label` for assistive tech; localize it (*Valmis*, *Vedos*). **Don't:** Don’t replace a labeled page-header chip (“Valmis”) with StatusDot — that is [Badge](/?path=/docs/core-atoms-badge--docs) (`dot` + label). Don’t use StatusDot as a click target — that is Chip or Menu. Don’t omit `label`; a pip without a name is silent to AT.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` | — | Accessible name (`aria-label`). No visible text. |
| `intent` | `'neutral' \| 'info' \| 'success' \| 'caution' \| 'critical' \| 'admin'` | `'neutral'` | Feedback fill. |

### Swatch

_Source: `apps/storybook/src/core/atoms/Swatch/Swatch.mdx` · [Storybook](/?path=/docs/core-atoms-swatch--docs)_

**Why:** Product data often carries user-chosen or world-authored colors (faction banners, dye vials, map markers) that do not belong to the semantic feedback palette. Swatch encapsulates the inline `--eevenkoto-swatch-color` bridge, hairline contrast boundary, `forced-colors: active` preservation (`forced-color-adjust: none`), and `print-color-adjust: exact` in one shared atom.

**When:** **Do:** Render data-driven pigments (heraldry, equipment dyes, map layers) with a hairline boundary. Pass `label` when the swatch stands alone; omit `label` when paired next to visible text (decorative `aria-hidden="true"`) or use [Chip](/?path=/docs/core-atoms-chip--docs) `swatchColor`. Use `shape="rounded"` when matching square/tile controls, or keep the default `circle` alongside inline labels. **Don't:** Don’t use Swatch for workflow readiness or status — use [StatusDot](/?path=/docs/core-atoms-statusdot--docs) or [Badge](/?path=/docs/core-atoms-badge--docs). Don’t make Swatch an interactive button — use [Chip](/?path=/docs/core-atoms-chip--docs) with `swatchColor` when the user selects or toggles a color filter. Don’t pass a duplicate `label` when the color name is already printed next to it.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `color` | `string` | — | CSS color value bound to `--eevenkoto-swatch-color`. |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `'md'` | Sample box size (`1.2rem` / `1.6rem` / `2.4rem`). |
| `shape` | `'circle' \| 'rounded'` | `'circle'` | Circle (`radius-full`) or rounded square (`radius-sm`). |
| `label` | `string` | — | Accessible name (`role="img"` + `aria-label`). Omit when decorative. |

### TableCell

_Source: `apps/storybook/src/core/atoms/TableCell/TableCell.mdx` · [Storybook](/?path=/docs/core-atoms-tablecell--docs)_

**Why:** Tabular columns need distinct alignment and width roles (`index`, `numeric`, `text`) plus optional angled numeric headers without repeating cell CSS across custom tables.

**When:** Compose `TableCell` automatically via [Table](/?path=/docs/core-molecules-table--docs), or use `TableCell` directly when building custom `<thead>` / `<tbody>` rows (pass `inTable` under `.eevenkoto-table` to omit redundant default classes).

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` | `'index' \| 'numeric' \| 'text'` | `'text'` | Column role (`eevenkoto-table-cell--*`). |
| `inTable` | `boolean` | `false` | Omits redundant host/`--text` classes when nested under `.eevenkoto-table`. |
| `text` | `string` | — | Plain-text cell copy (`children` / default slot in React, Vue, and Astro). |
| `html` | `string` | — | Trusted pre-rendered inline HTML (takes precedence over `text`). |
| `header` | `boolean` | `false` | Renders `<th>` instead of `<td>`. |
| `scope` | `'col' \| 'row' \| 'colgroup' \| 'rowgroup'` | — | `scope` attribute when `header` is `true`. |
| `colSpan` | `number` | — | `colspan` attribute. |
| `rowSpan` | `number` | — | `rowspan` attribute. |
| `angled` | `boolean` | `false` | Wraps header label for angled numeric heads (`numeric` + `header`). |
| `attributes` | `TableElementAttributes` | — | Extra HTML/data/ARIA attributes on `<th>` / `<td>`. |
| `tabIndex` | `number` | — | `tabindex` attribute (HTML/Astro; React/Vue via host attributes). |
| `id` | `string` | — | Cell element `id` (React, Vue, and Astro HTML attributes, or `attributes.id` in HTML). |

### Toast

_Source: `apps/storybook/src/core/atoms/Toast/Toast.mdx` · [Storybook](/?path=/docs/core-atoms-toast--docs)_

**Why:** Interactive tools, workshops, and content authoring flows require immediate, unobtrusive confirmation after actions like copying to clipboard, auto-saving, or toggling state. Toast encapsulates the visual presentation, icon mapping, accessible ARIA roles, and motion transitions without coupling you to a complex singleton runtime.

**When:** **Do:** Use for transient success, status updates, or brief non-blocking warnings (e.g., "Kopioitu leikepöydälle!"). Let `intent` automatically select appropriate icons and ARIA attributes (`status` vs `alert`). Pair with `placement="fixed-bottom-right"` or `placement="fixed-bottom-center"` when anchoring to viewport edge. Use `visible={false}` / `--hidden` to smoothly transition out. **Don't:** Don't use Toast for critical errors requiring explicit user confirmation — use a permanent [Notice](/?path=/docs/core-molecules-notice--docs) or dialog instead. Don't put interactive links or action buttons inside a Toast; toasts are transient and disappear quickly. Don't overload toasts with paragraphs of text; keep them to a single concise sentence.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | `string` | — | Toast message content. |
| `intent` | `'neutral' \| 'info' \| 'success' \| 'caution' \| 'critical' \| 'admin'` | `'neutral'` | Semantic feedback intent and default icon. |
| `variant` | `'subtle' \| 'solid'` | `'subtle'` | Fill intensity variant. |
| `placement` | `'inline' \| 'fixed-bottom-right' \| 'fixed-bottom-center'` | `'inline'` | Positioning strategy. |
| `visible` | `boolean` | `true` | Visibility state for entry/exit transitions. |
| `hidden` | `boolean` | `false` | Convenience inverse alias for `visible={false}` (`eevenkoto-toast--hidden`). |
| `icon` | `IconName \| false` | *intent default* | Optional icon override, or `false` to omit icon. |

### Card
