_Source: `apps/storybook/src/core/molecules/Card/Card.mdx` · [Storybook](/?path=/docs/core-molecules-card--docs)_

**Why:** Item entries, paywall summaries, and other self-contained chunks need a surface with optional title and footer chrome — not a full page layout and not a bare Frame. Card owns that sectioned box so products do not invent one-off bordered panels for every teaser. Copy-paste HTML is a document (`article` + heading), not a div sandwich.

**When:** **Do:** Author real `<article>` / `<header>` / `<h2>` / `<p>` / `<footer>` (or pass `title` / `body` / `footer` to `renderCard`). Group related content that reads as one unit (item card, gate summary, teaser). Omit unused sections — body-only is still a valid Card. Use `elevated` when the card should float above the page (overlays, pinned summaries). Keep the host as `<article>` and put `href` on an inner `<a>` so `header` / `footer` stay scoped to the card (eevenko.to `.doc-card`). Use [Catalog](/?path=/docs/core-molecules-catalog--docs) for dense entity indexes (`.entity-item`), not Card. **Don't:** Don’t use Card for dense entity indexes — that is Catalog. Don’t use Card for status or gate banners — that is Notice. Don’t nest Cards for decoration alone. Don’t swap the host to `<a>` — inner `header` / `footer` would belong to the page, not the card. Don’t mark a Card interactive without a real `href` (or button) — hover alone is not enough. Don’t bake product layout or paywall copy into the Card API — keep strings as data.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `surface` | `'raised' \| 'subtle' \| 'sunken'` | `'raised'` | Surface fill tier (`eevenkoto-card--surface-*`). |
| `accent` | `'none' \| 'top' \| 'start' \| 'outline'` | `'none'` | Structural gold edge or outline (`eevenkoto-card--accent-*`). |
| `current` | `boolean` | `false` | Active/selected card ring + border (`eevenkoto-card--current`). |
| `layout` | `'stack' \| 'split'` | `'stack'` | Content/actions arrangement (`eevenkoto-card--split`). |
| `elevated` | `boolean` | `false` | Adds depth shadow (`eevenkoto-card--elevated`). |
| `interactive` | `boolean` | `false` | Hover/focus affordance for inner link/button (`eevenkoto-card--interactive`). |
| `title` | `string` | — | Heading text inside `<header>`. |
| `titleHtml` | `string` | — | Trusted pre-rendered inline HTML for `<header>` heading (takes precedence over `title`). |
| `titleLevel` | `2 \| 3` | `2` | Heading level (`h2` or `h3`) for `title` / `titleHtml`. |
| `header` | `string` / slot | — | Custom `<header>` content (`header` prop in HTML/React; `#header` / `slot="header"` in Vue/Astro). |
| `headerActions` | `string` / slot | — | Trailing chrome inside `<header>` (`.eevenkoto-card__header-actions`). |
| `body` | `string` | — | Body copy rendered as `<p>` when slots/`bodyHtml` are omitted. |
| `bodyHtml` | `string` | — | Trusted pre-rendered HTML for card body copy (takes precedence over `body`). |
| `content` | `string` / slot | — | Main card body (`content` in `@eevenkoto/html`; `children` / default slot in React, Vue, and Astro). |
| `actions` | `string` / slot | — | Action group slot (`.eevenkoto-card__actions`), inline-end in `split` layout. |
| `footer` | `string` / slot | — | Footer content inside `<footer>`. |
| `href` | `string` | — | Wraps inner content in `<a href>` and enables `--interactive` across HTML, React, Vue, and Astro. |
| `id` | `string` | — | Host `<article id>` (React, Vue, and Astro HTML attributes). |

### Catalog

_Source: `apps/storybook/src/core/molecules/Catalog/Catalog.mdx` · [Storybook](/?path=/docs/core-molecules-catalog--docs)_

**Why:** Spell, creature, and culture indexes need compact linked rows in a wrapping grid. Card is too tall; List is a vertical stack; Menu is navigation chrome. Catalog is that index so eevenko.to can drop `.entity-grid` / `.entity-item`.

**When:** **Do:** Entity or page indexes (spells, opponents, cultures). Use [Card](/?path=/docs/core-molecules-card--docs) `--interactive` for sectioned teasers (category / title / meta — eevenko.to `.doc-card`). Use [Menu](/?path=/docs/core-molecules-menu--docs) for the worldbook sidebar, not a catalog of pages. **Don't:** Don’t use Catalog for a three-part teaser card — that is Card. Don’t use Catalog for running prose lists — that is List / Prose. Don’t invent a layout utility kit; Catalog’s grid is specific to these tiles.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tiles` | `CatalogTileProps[]` | — | Grid items. |
| `label` | `string` | — | Accessible name for the list. |

| `href` | `string` | — | Destination (required). |
| `status` | `BadgeIntent` | — | Leading StatusDot. |
| `statusLabel` | `string` | `'Ready'` | AT name for the pip. |
| `locked` | `boolean` | `false` | Trailing lock. |
| `lockedLabel` | `string` | `'Locked'` | AT name for the lock. |

### CheckboxGroup

_Source: `apps/storybook/src/core/molecules/CheckboxGroup/CheckboxGroup.mdx` · [Storybook](/?path=/docs/core-molecules-checkboxgroup--docs)_

**Why:** Lists of related checkboxes require an accessible group name for screen readers, visual alignment, and frequently need capacity tracking badges (such as "2 / 3 valittu" in equipment craft systems or character creators). CheckboxGroup standardizes this layout and accessibility pattern.

**When:** **Do:** Use CheckboxGroup whenever 2 or more checkboxes form a conceptual set. Use the `badge` and `badgeIntent` props to display live counters or resource limits. Use `layout="grid"` for compact multi-column card selectors. **Don't:** Don't group unrelated checkboxes under a single arbitrary fieldset. Don't omit the `label` — use `legendVisuallyHidden` if the label is already evident from adjacent headings.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | — | Fieldset `id` (React, Vue, and Astro HTML attributes). |
| `name` | `string` | — | Shared `name` passed to declarative `items` when item `name` is omitted. |
| `label` | `string` | **required** | Group legend label. |
| `legendVisuallyHidden` | `boolean` | `false` | Visually hide the legend while keeping it accessible (`eevenkoto-visually-hidden`). |
| `hideLegend` | `boolean` | `false` | Convenience alias for `legendVisuallyHidden`. |
| `layout` | `'stack' \| 'grid'` | `'stack'` (`'grid'` when `columns` is set) | Arrangement of items. |
| `columns` | `2 \| 3` | `2` | Column count for grid layout (automatically infers `layout="grid"` if `layout` is omitted). |
| `badge` | `string` | — | Header badge counter text. |
| `badgeIntent` | `'neutral' \| 'critical'` | `'neutral'` | Color intent of the badge. |
| `hint` | `string` | — | Explanatory helper text. |
| `error` | `string` | — | Validation error text (`role="alert"`). |
| `items` | `CheckboxGroupItemProps[]` | — | Declarative list of checkboxes. |

### ChipGroup

_Source: `apps/storybook/src/core/molecules/ChipGroup/ChipGroup.mdx` · [Storybook](/?path=/docs/core-molecules-chipgroup--docs)_

**Why:** One accessible structure (group name, per-chip `aria-pressed`) for filters and color pickers, with leading `icon` and `swatchColor` support and disabled chips that keep their contrast.

**When:** - Use for compact, visible filter or picker options. - Use `hideLegend` when the heading is already on screen (the legend stays for screen readers). - Don't use for exclusive form choices that need native radios — use [RadioGroup](/?path=/docs/core-molecules-radiogroup--docs).

### Disclosure

_Source: `apps/storybook/src/core/molecules/Disclosure/Disclosure.mdx` · [Storybook](/?path=/docs/core-molecules-disclosure--docs)_

**Why:** Keyboard- and screen-reader-accessible expand/collapse with no JavaScript, tokenized surfaces and focus ring, and forced-colors and print support.

**When:** - Use for optional detail, FAQs, and grouped filters. - Use `variant="flush"` inside cards or lists, `emphasized` for a focal item. - Don't use it for primary navigation — use [Menu](/?path=/docs/core-molecules-menu--docs).

### Field

_Source: `apps/storybook/src/core/molecules/Field/Field.mdx` · [Storybook](/?path=/docs/core-molecules-field--docs)_

**Why:** Form controls fail WCAG when the name is only a placeholder, or when invalid state is red chrome with no words. Field owns the visible label and the hint/error message so that contract stays consistent — Input stays control chrome, not a half-built form row.

**When:** **Do:** Always show a visible label for form data entry. When invalid, set `error` on Field and `invalid` + `describedBy` on Input (same message id). Use `hint` for helper text; it yields to `error` when both would apply. Keep placeholder as an example value only. **Don't:** Don’t mark a field invalid with red chrome and no error string. Don’t use placeholder (or aria-label alone) instead of a visible label in forms. Don’t omit `htmlFor` / matching Input `id` — the label must associate.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` | — | Visible label. |
| `htmlFor` | `string` | slug from label (HTML) | Control id. |
| `orientation` | `'vertical' \| 'horizontal'` | `'vertical'` | Label/control layout axis. |
| `hint` | `string` | — | Helper text when no error. |
| `error` | `string` | — | Error text (takes priority over hint). |
| `messageId` | `string` | `` `${htmlFor}-message` `` | Id for `aria-describedby`. |
| `control` | `string` | — | HTML package: nested control markup. |
| `action` | `string \| ReactNode` (slot in Vue/Astro) | — | Optional trailing inline action inside `__control-group`. |

### FloatingBanner

_Source: `apps/storybook/src/core/molecules/FloatingBanner/FloatingBanner.mdx` · [Storybook](/?path=/docs/core-molecules-floatingbanner--docs)_

**Why:** One accessible, token-driven pattern for consent and announcement bars: `aside` landmark, `--eevenkoto-z-overlay` layering, responsive stacking, forced-colors support.

**When:** - Use for persistent, dismissible site-level notices (cookies, policy changes). - Wire dismissal yourself: toggle `open`, or listen via `confirmId` (HTML), `onConfirm` (React), `@confirm` (Vue). - Don't use it for transient feedback — use [Toast](/?path=/docs/core-atoms-toast--docs); for inline messages use [Notice](/?path=/docs/core-molecules-notice--docs).

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | — | DOM id. |
| `open` | `boolean` | `false` | Show the banner. |
| `placement` | `'bottom-center' \| 'bottom-right'` | `'bottom-center'` | Viewport anchor. |
| `ariaLabel` | `string` | — | Landmark name (required). |
| `body` / `bodyHtml` | `string` | — | Plain or trusted HTML copy (slot/children wins). |
| `secondaryLink` | `{ label; href }` | — | Inline link after the copy. |
| `confirmLabel` / `confirmId` | `string` | — | Built-in primary button and its id. |
| `actions` | slot / prop | — | Replaces the built-in button. |

### Flow

_Source: `apps/storybook/src/core/molecules/Flow/Flow.mdx` · [Storybook](/?path=/docs/core-molecules-flow--docs)_

**Why:** Type primitives carry default block margins for standalone stories, but bare margins collapse unpredictably in mixed stacks and boxed components (`Notice`, `Card`, `TableShell`, `Divider`) need consistent outer separation around them. Flow resets child block margins and applies pair-aware `margin-block-start` gaps instead.

**When:** Wrap any vertical stack of Heading / Paragraph / Caption / List, boxed blocks, and nested Flows in `eevenkoto-flow`. For bare CMS/`h*`/`p`/`ul`/`ol` markup, compose with [Prose](/?path=/docs/core-molecules-prose--docs) (`eevenkoto-prose eevenkoto-flow`).

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `density` | `'tight' \| 'loose'` | — | Optional vertical rhythm scale (`eevenkoto-flow--tight` / `--loose`). |
| `content` | `string` | — | HTML package: inner HTML (`children` / default slot in React, Vue, and Astro). |
| `id` | `string` | — | Host element `id` (React, Vue, and Astro HTML attributes). |

### List

_Source: `apps/storybook/src/core/molecules/List/List.mdx` · [Storybook](/?path=/docs/core-molecules-list--docs)_

**Why:** Reading content often needs bulleted or numbered steps. Real `ul` / `ol` / `li` keep semantics honest for assistive tech and let Prose style bare CMS tags the same way as classed Lists.

**When:** Use List for unordered or ordered content lists in reading layouts. Prefer PropertyList for vitals and other definitional metadata. Prefer Paragraph for multi-sentence prose without markers.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `ListItemProps[]` | — | Rows to render. |
| `variant` | `'unordered' \| 'ordered' \| 'checklist'` | `unordered` | List kind / element. |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `md` | Body type size. |
| `tone` | `'primary' \| 'secondary'` | `primary` | Content color. |
| `text` (item) | `string` | — | Item copy. |
| `html` (item) | `string` | — | Trusted pre-rendered inline HTML (takes precedence over `text`). |
| `status` (item) | `'included' \| 'accent' \| 'excluded'` | `'included'` (in checklist) | Checklist row status icon and treatment. |

### Menu

_Source: `apps/storybook/src/core/molecules/Menu/Menu.mdx` · [Storybook](/?path=/docs/core-molecules-menu--docs)_

**Why:** Account menus, view switchers, and worldbook sidebars all need a compact vertical list of destinations. Menu owns that chrome — flat rows for standalone plaques and [Popover](/?path=/docs/core-atoms-popover--docs) menus, nested `group` branches for eevenko.to-style trees — without baking open/position or routing into the DS. Copy-paste HTML navigates with no app JS.

**When:** **Do:** Author real `<a href>` rows (or pass `href` to `renderMenu`) so the menu works as a document. Use flat items (+ header/separator) for account and action menus, standalone or inside [Popover](/?path=/docs/core-atoms-popover--docs) (Menu sheds its redundant outer plaque automatically when nested directly inside Popover). Use nested `kind: 'group'` for multi-level nav (chapter → subsection → leaf links), as on eevenko.to. Hand HTML is `<li><details>` with a nested `<ul>`. Put an overview page as the first child link when a section has both an index and children (e.g. “Lajit” link under the Lajit branch). Set `expanded` on a group (or the `open` attribute on `details`) when that branch should start open (current section). Set `embedded` when the menu sits in a sunken sidebar (transparent, flush, no plaque border). Pass `icon` for an optional leading [Icon](/?path=/docs/core-atoms-icon--docs), `status` + `statusLabel` for a trailing [StatusDot](/?path=/docs/core-atoms-statusdot--docs), or `locked` for a gating lock glyph. Labels truncate with ellipsis. **Don't:** Don’t default to inert `<button>` rows in HTML. Buttons are an escape hatch for in-page commands with no URL. Don’t fake nesting with only `header` + visual indent — use `group` / `details`. Don’t put role="menu" + arrow-key behavior on the host unless the app also implements that contract (host is `<nav>`). Don’t wrap Menu in a second `<nav>` — the host is already the landmark. Don’t use Menu for page body outlines — that is Heading + Flow / Prose.

| Entry `kind` | Fields |
| --- | --- |
| `item` (default) | `id`, `label`, `icon?`, `tone?` (`'default' \| 'destructive'`), `href?`, `selected?`, `disabled?`, `locked?`, `lockedLabel?`, `status?`, `statusLabel?`, `attributes?` (`MenuAttributes` for framework hooks such as HTMX / data attributes) |
| `header` | `id?`, `label`, `attributes?` |
| `separator` | `id?`, `attributes?` |
| `group` | `id`, `label`, `icon?`, `expanded?`, `attributes?`, `children: MenuEntry[]` |

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `entries` | `MenuEntry[]` | — | List data. |
| `label` | `string` | — | Accessible name (`aria-label` on `nav`). |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md'` | `'md'` | Shared control size ladder (`eevenkoto-menu--sm` / `--md`). |
| `embedded` | `boolean` | `false` | Transparent flush surface for sidebars. |
| `id` | `string` | — | Host `<nav id>` (React, Vue, and Astro HTML attributes). |

### Notice

_Source: `apps/storybook/src/core/molecules/Notice/Notice.mdx` · [Storybook](/?path=/docs/core-molecules-notice--docs)_

**Why:** Readers need a scannable block that signals status — locked section, success, caution — with the same intent language as Badge, but as a banner rather than a chip. Notice owns that feedback surface so products do not paint Card or Paragraph in feedback colors.

**When:** **Do:** Announce status, gates, warnings, and confirmations with the matching `intent`. Let `role` follow intent (`status` on neutral/info/success/admin, `alert` on caution/critical), or pass `role="note"` / `"status"` explicitly when a static callout should not interrupt AT. Put actions (Sign in, Dismiss) in the actions slot — compose Button, don’t invent local CTAs. Pick `subtle` / `outline` / `solid` for how loud the banner is. **Don't:** Don’t use Notice as a content Card (item entries, teasers, sectioned articles). Don’t restyle Card with feedback fills to fake a Notice. Don’t bake paywall layout or product chrome into the Notice API — keep title/body/actions as data. Don’t force `role="alert"` on informational notices — it interrupts AT unnecessarily.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `intent` | `'neutral' \| 'info' \| 'success' \| 'caution' \| 'critical' \| 'admin'` | `'neutral'` | Feedback color intent (`eevenkoto-notice--{intent}`). |
| `variant` | `'subtle' \| 'outline' \| 'solid'` | `'subtle'` | Surface loudness (`eevenkoto-notice--{variant}`). |
| `title` | `string` | — | Bold heading line in `__title` (`line-height-snug`). |
| `body` | `string` | — | Plain-text body copy in `__body` (optional when using slots or `bodyHtml`). |
| `bodyHtml` | `string` | — | Trusted pre-rendered HTML for `__body` (takes precedence over `body`). |
| `icon` | `IconName \| false` | intent default (`info`, `check`, `warning`, `star`) | Leading decorative Icon, or `false` to omit. |
| `role` | `'status' \| 'alert' \| 'note' \| 'region'` | `'alert'` for `caution`/`critical`, `'status'` otherwise | ARIA landmark/live-region role. |
| `statusText` | `string` | — | Polite live-region confirmation line (`__status`). |
| `actions` | `string` / slot | — | Action controls rendered inside `__actions`. |
| `id` | `string` | — | Host element `id` (React, Vue, and Astro HTML attributes). |

### PropertyList

_Source: `apps/storybook/src/core/molecules/PropertyList/PropertyList.mdx` · [Storybook](/?path=/docs/core-molecules-propertylist--docs)_

**Why:** Combat vitals, casting bands, equipment stats, skills, senses, and summary tiles are definitional metadata. A real `dl` exposes that relationship to assistive tech across stacked rows, hairline-divided lists, multi-column bands, and bordered stat cards — without bold Paragraph + `<br>` scaffolding.

**When:** **Do:** Vitals and details inside AbilityScoreGroup header/footer rails (`inline`). Summary drawers or sidebars that benefit from row hairlines (`divided`). Casting-property bands or 2–4 column metadata strips (`grid`). Equipment / character summary tiles with secondary `meta` lines (`cards`). **Don't:** Don’t fake properties with `<strong>Label:</strong>` and line breaks. Don’t include the colon in `label` — CSS appends or omits it per layout. Don’t render a bare Property outside a PropertyList `dl` (invalid / incomplete semantics).

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` (list) | `PropertyItem[]` | — | Rows to render. |
| `layout` (list) | `'inline' \| 'divided' \| 'grid' \| 'cards'` | `'inline'` | Visual arrangement of definition pairs. |
| `columns` (list) | `2 \| 3 \| 4` | `4` (`grid`) / `2` (`cards`) | Column count for `grid` and `cards` layouts. |
| `label` (item) | `string` | — | Term (no colon). |
| `value` (item) | `string` | — | Primary detail text. |
| `valueHtml` (item) | `string` | — | Trusted pre-rendered inline HTML for `dd`. |
| `meta` (item) | `string \| string[]` | — | Optional secondary metadata line(s) stacked below `value`. |

### Prose

_Source: `apps/storybook/src/core/molecules/Prose/Prose.mdx` · [Storybook](/?path=/docs/core-molecules-prose--docs)_

**Why:** CMS HTML, markdown, and editorial content often ship tags without DS classes. Prose opts those tags into the type system without restyling every `h1`/`p`/`ul` in the document.

**When:** Use Prose around rendered Markdown, CMS HTML, or long-form editorial sections where elements arrive without BEM classes; add `eevenkoto-flow` alongside `eevenkoto-prose` when you want pair-aware vertical rhythm.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `content` | `string` | — | HTML package: inner HTML string (`children` / default slot in React, Vue, and Astro). |

### RadioGroup

_Source: `apps/storybook/src/core/molecules/RadioGroup/RadioGroup.mdx` · [Storybook](/?path=/docs/core-molecules-radiogroup--docs)_

**Why:** Groups of mutually exclusive choices need an accessible group name for screen readers, keyboard arrow navigation between options, and layout options for cards with rich descriptions or compact grid tiles.

**When:** **Do:** Use RadioGroup when the user must select exactly one option from 2 to 7 visible choices. Use `variant="card"` when options have descriptive subtitles or mechanics text. Use `variant="tile"` with `layout="grid"` for compact multi-column selectors. **Don't:** Don't use RadioGroup when multiple selections are allowed — use **CheckboxGroup**. Don't use RadioGroup for long lists (8+ items) in cramped dialogs — use **Select**.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | — | Fieldset `id` (React, Vue, and Astro HTML attributes). |
| `name` | `string` | **required** | Shared name attribute for child radios. |
| `label` | `string` | **required** | Group legend label. |
| `legendVisuallyHidden` | `boolean` | `false` | Visually hide the legend while keeping it accessible (`eevenkoto-visually-hidden`). |
| `hideLegend` | `boolean` | `false` | Convenience alias for `legendVisuallyHidden`. |
| `value` | `string` | — | Currently selected value. |
| `defaultValue` | `string` | — | Initial selected value if uncontrolled. |
| `layout` | `'stack' \| 'grid'` | `'stack'` (`'grid'` when `columns` is set) | Arrangement of items. |
| `columns` | `2 \| 3` | `2` | Column count for grid layout (automatically infers `layout="grid"` if `layout` is omitted). |
| `variant` | `'default' \| 'card' \| 'tile'` | `'default'` | Shared option variant. |
| `badge` | `string` | — | Optional header badge text. |
| `badgeIntent` | `'neutral' \| 'critical'` | `'neutral'` | Color intent of the header badge. |
| `hint` | `string` | — | Explanatory helper text. |
| `error` | `string` | — | Validation error text (`role="alert"`). |
| `options` | `RadioGroupOptionProps[]` | — | Declarative list of radio options. |

### SectionHeader

_Source: `apps/storybook/src/core/molecules/SectionHeader/SectionHeader.mdx` · [Storybook](/?path=/docs/core-molecules-sectionheader--docs)_

**Why:** Pages repeat the same kicker/title/lead/CTA arrangement. SectionHeader keeps heading levels explicit (`titleLevel`) and spacing consistent while composing Caption, Heading and Paragraph.

**When:** - Use at the top of a page section or as a centered hero. - Choose `titleLevel` from document structure, not from desired size. - Don't use it for card titles — use [Card](/?path=/docs/core-molecules-card--docs).

### Segmented Control

_Source: `apps/storybook/src/core/molecules/SegmentedControl/SegmentedControl.mdx` · [Storybook](/?path=/docs/core-molecules-segmentedcontrol--docs)_

**Why:** Mutually exclusive short options often need to stay visible as a compact track — not hidden in a select or scattered as separate Buttons. Segmented Control is that exclusive-choice chrome for in-page radios or navigational link sets.

**When:** **Do:** **Radios** for an in-page setting that stays on this document. **Links** when each option is a different URL (Full text vs Short SRD). Give each option its own `tone` when selected fills should differ (e.g. Text = primary, SRD = secondary). Keep option labels short. Provide an accessible name via `label` (legend / `aria-label`). **Don't:** Don’t put `--selected` on radio labels — it sticks after a native change. Radios paint selection only from `:checked`. Don’t use buttons + `aria-pressed` for a whole exclusive track — that is this component, not a row of Chips. Don’t use `role="switch"` for labeled alternatives (Text / SRD). Don’t use Segmented Control for multi-select filters — use [ChipGroup](/?path=/docs/core-molecules-chipgroup--docs) or [CheckboxGroup](/?path=/docs/core-molecules-checkboxgroup--docs).

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `options` | `SegmentedControlOption[]` | **required** | Exclusive options (`{ id, label, icon?, href?, disabled?, tone? }`). |
| `mode` | `'radios' \| 'links'` | `'radios'` | `radios` (`<fieldset>` + native radios) or `links` (`<nav>` + `<a href>`). |
| `selectedId` | `string` | — | Initial `checked` radio (`radios`) or `aria-current="page"` + `--selected` (`links`). |
| `name` | `string` | — | Shared radio group `name` (required when `mode="radios"`). |
| `tone` | `'primary' \| 'secondary'` | `'primary'` | Default selected fill tone when an option omits `tone`. |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md'` | `'md'` | Shared control size ladder (`control-sm` / `control-md`). |
| `label` | `string` | — | Accessible name (visually-hidden `<legend>` or `<nav aria-label>`). |
| `fullWidth` | `boolean` | `false` | Stretches track and options across available inline space (`eevenkoto-segmented-control--full-width`). |
| `id` | `string` | — | Host element `id` (React, Vue, and Astro HTML attributes). |

### Stepper

_Source: `apps/storybook/src/core/molecules/Stepper/Stepper.mdx` · [Storybook](/?path=/docs/core-molecules-stepper--docs)_

**Why:** TTRPG systems regularly feature bounded small integer increments (armor reinforcement ranks, damage bonus pips, inventory quantities). Free-form text fields often fail validation or require extra typing on mobile devices. Steppers provide fast one-tap adjustment and bound enforcement.

**When:** **Do:** Use Stepper for small integer values typically adjusted by 1 (e.g. ranks 0–5, quantities 1–20). Use descriptions to explain what each increment grants in game mechanics (e.g. "+1 PL (+50 % hinta)"). Specify `min` and `max` to prevent illegal system states. **Don't:** Don't use Stepper for large arbitrary numbers (e.g. 5,000 gold pieces) — use **Input** with `type="number"`. Don't use Stepper without a clear `label` identifying what is being adjusted.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | — | Group element `id` (React, Vue, and Astro). |
| `name` | `string` | — | Optional field identifier (`data-field` / `data-stepper-val` in HTML renderer). |
| `label` | `string` | **required** | Primary visible title. |
| `description` | `string` | — | Optional mechanics explanation. |
| `value` | `number` | **required** | Current numeric value. |
| `min` | `number` | `0` | Minimum allowed value. |
| `max` | `number` | — | Optional maximum allowed value. |
| `step` | `number` | `1` | Increment / decrement step size. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disabled state. |
| `decreaseAriaLabel` | `string` | `'Vähennä'` | Accessible label on the decrement button. |
| `increaseAriaLabel` | `string` | `'Lisää'` | Accessible label on the increment button. |

### TableOfContents

_Source: `apps/storybook/src/core/molecules/TableOfContents/TableOfContents.mdx` · [Storybook](/?path=/docs/core-molecules-tableofcontents--docs)_

**Why:** Long documents need a navigable outline that works without JavaScript, stays reachable on mobile, and is skipped in print. Links use `data-toc-target` (never duplicate ids), so one scrollspy updates both presentations.

**When:** - Use `variant="auto"` for document pages with a side column. - Use `rail` inside a layout you already control, `collapsible` for single-column pages. - Don't use it for site navigation — use [Menu](/?path=/docs/core-molecules-menu--docs).

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | — | DOM id on `<nav>`. |
| `label` | `string` | `'Table of contents'` | Landmark `aria-label`. |
| `groups` | `TableOfContentsGroup[]` | — | `{ id?, label?, items: { id, href, label, current? }[] }`. |
| `variant` | `'auto' \| 'rail' \| 'collapsible'` | `'auto'` | Presentation. |
| `toggleLabel` | `string` | `'On this page'` | Rail heading and disclosure summary. |
| `open` | `boolean` | `false` | Start the disclosure open. |

### Table

_Source: `apps/storybook/src/core/molecules/Table/Table.mdx` · [Storybook](/?path=/docs/core-molecules-table--docs)_

**Why:** Rulebooks and tools rely on real `<table>` charts (class progression, roll lookups, equipment catalogs) with tabular numerals, angled numeric headers, and row/column striping that work in screen readers and print without ad-hoc table CSS.

**When:** Use Table for true multi-column tabular data or roll/index lookup charts. Wrap wide tables in [TableShell](/?path=/docs/core-organisms-tableshell--docs) (or Domain [ContentTable](/?path=/docs/domain-molecules-contenttable--docs) when rows carry readiness states or spanning locked-tier Notices), and use [PropertyList](/?path=/docs/core-molecules-propertylist--docs) for single-entity label→value pairs.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `columns` | `TableColumn[]` | **required** | Header columns (`{ key, header, kind? }`). |
| `rows` | `TableRowInput[]` | **required** | Row cells (`string[][]`, `TableCellObject[]`, or `TableRowObject` with `attributes` + `cells`). |
| `caption` | `string` | — | Optional `<caption>` copy. |
| `variant` | `'default' \| 'numeric' \| 'pair'` | `'default'` | Table layout recipe (`eevenkoto-table--numeric` / `--pair`). |
| `stripe` | `'row' \| 'column' \| 'none'` | `'row'` | Alternating surface band (`eevenkoto-table--stripe-column` / `--stripe-none`). |
| `id` | `string` | — | Host `<table id>` (React, Vue, and Astro HTML attributes). |

### Tooltip Card

_Source: `apps/storybook/src/core/molecules/TooltipCard/TooltipCard.mdx` · [Storybook](/?path=/docs/core-molecules-tooltipcard--docs)_

**Why:** Preview panels need a compact elevated surface with an optional title, scrollable body, and footer link — without inventing a one-off panel or overloading page [Card](/?path=/docs/core-molecules-card--docs). TooltipCard is that chrome; Popover owns placement.

**When:** **Do:** Nest TooltipCard as a direct Popover child for entity / topic previews. Author real `<header>` / `<h2>` / `<footer>` (or pass `title` / `footer` to `renderTooltipCard`). Raise `--eevenkoto-tooltip-card-body-max-block-size` when a panel should show more before it scrolls. Keep footer actions as data (e.g. “Avaa sivu”) — not baked into the molecule API. Pair with InlineRef (Core) or EntityRef (Domain) as the trigger — app owns open / position. **Don't:** Don’t use TooltipCard as an in-page Card for item listings or teasers. Don’t use Card inside Popover as a substitute for TooltipCard (double chrome / wrong elevation recipe). Don’t make Core demos depend on Domain EntityRef — use InlineRef. Don’t ship tooltip show/hide JS in the DS — that stays in the app.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `string` | — | Visible heading inside `<header>`. |
| `titleLevel` | `2 \| 3` | `2` | Heading level (`h2` or `h3`) for `title`. |
| `header` | `string` / slot | — | Custom `<header>` content (`header` prop in HTML/React; `#header` / `slot="header"` in Vue/Astro). |
| `body` | `string` | — | Plain-text body copy rendered in `__body` (compact `body-sm` interior rhythm). |
| `bodyHtml` | `string` | — | Trusted pre-rendered HTML for `__body` (takes precedence over `body`). |
| `content` | `string` / slot | — | Scrollable body content (`content` in `@eevenkoto/html`; `children` / default slot in React, Vue, and Astro). |
| `footer` | `string` / slot | — | Pinned footer content inside `<footer>`. |
| `flush` | `boolean` | `false` | Zeroes `__body` padding for full-bleed embedded blocks (`eevenkoto-tooltip-card--flush`). |
| `id` | `string` | — | Host element `id` (React, Vue, and Astro HTML attributes). |

### Workshop

_Source: `apps/storybook/src/core/organisms/Workshop/Workshop.mdx` · [Storybook](/?path=/docs/core-organisms-workshop--docs)_

**Why:** Interactive TTRPG generators (Creature, Encounter, Magic Item, Rumor rollers, and Equipment builders) share the same chassis ergonomics: structured header lockups, form controls, and a live statblock/card preview that collapses cleanly via `@container eevenkoto-workshop (max-width: 56rem)` without viewport breakout hacks.

**When:** - **`layout="split"` (default):** Full 2-column builders where controls sit on the inline-start rail and the live preview sticks on the inline-end rail (`sticky="preview"` by default, or `sticky="controls"` / `sticky="none"`). - **`layout="inline"`:** Compact single-column random tables and inline prose generators (`sticky` defaults to `'none'`). - Customize the controls track width via `controlsWidth` or `--eevenkoto-workshop-controls-width` (for example `minmax(0, 1fr)` for 50/50 columns or `24rem` for a fixed rail). Domain `EquipmentWorkshop` builds directly on `Workshop`.

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `layout` | `'split' \| 'inline'` | `'split'` | 2-column workbench (`'split'`) or single-column generator (`'inline'`) |
| `sticky` | `'preview' \| 'controls' \| 'none'` | `'preview'` (`'none'` in `inline`) | Sticky column behavior above `56rem` container width |
| `icon` | `IconName` | — | Optional decorative glyph inside `.eevenkoto-workshop__icon-badge` |
| `title` | `string` | — | Structured header title (`.eevenkoto-workshop__title`) |
| `titleLevel` | `2 \| 3` | `2` | Semantic heading tag level for `title` |
| `subtitle` | `string` | — | Optional muted subtitle (`.eevenkoto-workshop__subtitle`) |
| `header` | `string \| ReactNode` | — | Optional top header actions (mode switcher, presets, reroll button) |
| `controls` | `string \| ReactNode` | — | Controls column/stack (or default slot/children) |
| `toolbar` | `string \| ReactNode` | — | Sunken summary/export bar inside `.eevenkoto-workshop__preview` |
| `preview` | `string \| ReactNode` | — | Live output sheet |
| `footer` | `string \| ReactNode` | — | Top-bordered footer tray below `.eevenkoto-workshop__body` |
| `controlsWidth` | `string` | `minmax(0, 1.35fr)` | Sets `--eevenkoto-workshop-controls-width` |
| `label` | `string` | — | Adds `role="region"` + `aria-label` |
| `id` | `string` | — | Explicit host `<div id>` |

### AbilityName

_Source: `apps/storybook/src/domain/atoms/AbilityName/AbilityName.mdx` · [Storybook](/?path=/docs/domain-atoms-abilityname--docs)_

**Why:** Rules text and equipment blocks frequently reference abilities in constrained spaces (such as weapon stat cards or compact tables): - **Full readability by default:** Displays the full Finnish name (`Voimakkuus`) whenever space permits. - **Graceful degradation:** When space is cramped (e.g. in multi-column weapon stat cards or mobile screens), collapses automatically to the standard 3-letter abbreviation (`VOI`). - **Accessible:** Keeps the unabbreviated name in the accessibility tree via visually-hidden text while marking the 3-letter abbreviation `aria-hidden="true"`, so assistive technology reads the full ability name without prohibited ARIA attributes on generic inline spans.

**When:** **Do:** Use for presenting ability references in equipment cards, stat blocks, or rules text. Compose multiple abilities with conjunctions like `tai` or `/`. Let responsive CSS handle abbreviation whenever possible. **Don't:** Don't wrap entire phrases like "Voimakkuus tai Ketteryys" in a single AbilityName atom. Wrap each ability individually. Don't hardcode fixed abbreviations in content markup without an accessible full-name fallback.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `string` | — | Full ability name (e.g. `Voimakkuus` or `Sisu`). |
| `children` | `string \| ReactNode` | — | Alternative to `name` in Core, React, Vue, and Astro (`<AbilityName>Voimakkuus</AbilityName>`). |
| `short` | `string` | `3-letter ALLCAPS` | Optional custom abbreviation override. |
| `variant` | `'auto' \| 'full' \| 'short'` | `'auto'` | Force full or short display, or let container queries respond automatically. |

### Entity Ref

_Source: `apps/storybook/src/domain/atoms/EntityRef/EntityRef.mdx` · [Storybook](/?path=/docs/domain-atoms-entityref--docs)_

**Why:** Rules prose names other entities constantly. EntityRef marks those names with **kind-colored** ink so readers can tell a referenced term from ordinary words — without Badge chrome or a Button. Prefer bare [InlineRef](/?path=/docs/core-atoms-inlineref--docs) when you do not need a closed kind.

**When:** **Do:** Point at another rules entity inside body copy (*Frightened*, *Advantage*, *Cure Wounds*) when a kind color matters. Prefer a real `href` when the entity has a page — tooltips and deep links hang off that link. Keep the visible string as the entity **name**; localize the name in app data, not in the kind API. Use the closed `kind` set so ink and hover chip map to the right Tier 2 tuple. Use `kind: &apos;class&apos;` for class names (*Hurjapää*, *mystikko*) and `classFeature` for features (*Hurma*). Use `creature` for opponents (*Haukka*). Map gear (*tikari*, varuste/esine) to `item` — do not add a Finnish kind. Pass `locked` / `unlinked` from Core InlineRef instead of product lock SVGs or `.unlinked-term`. **Don't:** Don’t use EntityRef for a generic Core preview trigger — that is [InlineRef](/?path=/docs/core-atoms-inlineref--docs). Don’t use EntityRef for status or readiness — that is [Badge](/?path=/docs/core-atoms-badge--docs). Don’t invent open-ended kinds in props. New kinds are a design decision (CSS + `EntityRefKind`), not a free string. Don’t add `varuste` — that is `item`. Don’t keep a `.tooltip-ref` class that reassigns InlineRef bridges from `data-ref-tyyppi`. Don’t wrap EntityRef in a Button. The trigger for entity tooltips is the link itself. Don’t rely on a permanent filled chip in dense prose — rest state is ink + underline only.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `string` | — | Visible entity name. |
| `kind` | `EntityRefKind` | `'item'` | Closed kind set. |
| `href` | `string` | — | When set (and not `unlinked`), renders as `<a>`. |
| `unlinked` | `boolean` | `false` | Inherited from InlineRef. |
| `locked` | `boolean` | `false` | Inherited from InlineRef. |
| `lockedLabel` | `string` | `'Locked'` | Inherited from InlineRef. |

### AbilityScore

_Source: `apps/storybook/src/domain/molecules/AbilityScore/AbilityScore.mdx` · [Storybook](/?path=/docs/domain-molecules-abilityscore--docs)_

**Why:** Ability columns are decorative and positional (orbiting chips), but still need accessible terms for score / modifier / save. AbilityScore owns that column AT contract.

**When:** **Do:** Pass ability names as data (*Karisma*, *Ketteryys*) — never as core enums. Override `scoreLabel` / `modifierLabel` / `saveLabel` / `proficientLabel` for Finnish (*Arvo*, *Muuttuja*, *Pelastus*, *pätevä*). Set `saveProficient` when the creature is proficient — bright shield border only. **Don't:** Don’t use Badge for these numbers — Badge is feedback; Stat is content display. Don’t use bright gold on every chip — reserve `content-accent-strong` for proficient saves. Don’t style adjacent paragraphs into a sandwich — compose [AbilityScoreGroup](/?path=/docs/domain-organisms-abilityscoregroup--docs).

| `score` | `string` | — | Base score. |
| `modifier` | `string` | — | Modifier (typically signed). |
| `save` | `string` | — | Save bonus (typically signed). |

| `modifierLabel` | `string` | `'Modifier'` | Visually hidden term. |
| `saveLabel` | `string` | `'Save'` | Visually hidden term. |
| `saveProficient` | `boolean` | `false` | Emphasized shield + proficient suffix in the hidden term. |
| `proficientLabel` | `string` | `'proficient'` | Suffix inside the hidden save term when proficient. |

### LicenseBar

_Source: `apps/storybook/src/domain/molecules/LicenseBar/LicenseBar.mdx` · [Storybook](/?path=/docs/domain-molecules-licensebar--docs)_

**Why:** Which license a reading mode falls under is legal information that must be visible and consistent. The strip pairs a neutral readable surface with a thick hue edge (accent for proprietary, primary for open), so contrast never depends on a coloured fill.

**When:** - Use once per page to show the active content license and legal links. - Provide one entry per license; the active one is shown and the rest are `hidden`. - Use `placement="inline"` inside content or in print-oriented layouts; the `edge` stripe is hidden in print.

| `placement` | `'edge' \| 'inline'` | `'edge'` | Fixed vertical viewport stripe vs static inline row. |
| `entries` | `LicenseBarEntry[]` | **required** | License + links per mode (`{ license, links }`). |
| `separator` | `string` | `' · '` | Text separator between links. |

### NpcCard

_Source: `apps/storybook/src/domain/molecules/NpcCard/NpcCard.mdx` · [Storybook](/?path=/docs/domain-molecules-npccard--docs)_

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` / `nameHtml` | `string` | — | NPC name (`name` required unless `nameHtml` is passed; `nameHtml` is sanitized inline HTML). |
| `nameLevel` | `2 \| 3 \| 4` | `3` | Semantic heading level (`line-height-snug`). |
| `role` / `roleHtml` | `string` | — | Role / epithet line below the name. |
| `details` | `PropertyItem[]` | — | Divided PropertyList rows (`details`, never `traits`). |
| `body` / `bodyHtml` | `string` | — | Plain-text or trusted HTML description copy. |
| `id` | `string` | — | Host `<article id>`. |

### ReadAloudBox

_Source: `apps/storybook/src/domain/molecules/ReadAloudBox/ReadAloudBox.mdx` · [Storybook](/?path=/docs/domain-molecules-readaloudbox--docs)_

**Why:** Read-aloud text is a recognisable adventure convention. A dedicated component keeps it semantically an aside and visually consistent.

**When:** - Use for narration meant for players. - Do not use for GM-only notes — use Notice.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | — | Host `<aside id>`. |
| `label` | `string` | — | Accessible `aria-label` for the `<aside>`. |
| `ornament` | `string \| false` | `'❖'` | Decorative glyph; `false` hides it. |
| `body` / `bodyHtml` | `string` | — | Plain-text or trusted inline/block HTML copy (or default slot/children). |

### StatblockFeature

_Source: `apps/storybook/src/domain/molecules/StatblockFeature/StatblockFeature.mdx` · [Storybook](/?path=/docs/domain-molecules-statblockfeature--docs)_

**Why:** Feature names should participate in the document outline without orphaning a full-width heading above a one-line mechanic. Run-in H3 keeps the name on the same line as the body while remaining a real heading.

**When:** **Do:** Attacks, traits, bonus actions, reactions, legendary actions. Nest under [StatblockSection](/?path=/docs/domain-molecules-statblocksection--docs) (or any H2 cluster). Pass the name without a trailing period — CSS appends `.` via `::after`. **Don't:** Don’t fake the name with `<strong><em>` inside a Paragraph. Don’t use H6 for features inside a Statblock — that skips levels; use the run-in at the level the outline needs. Don’t put the colon or period in the `name` string.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `string` | — | Feature title (run-in heading). |
| `level` | `2 \| 3 \| 4 \| 5 \| 6` | `3` | Semantic heading level for `name`. Appearance is identical at every level. |
| `description` | `string` (HTML/Vue) / `ReactNode` (React) | — | Body after the run-in (Vue/Astro also support default slot). |
| `descriptionHtml` | `string` | — | Trusted pre-rendered inline HTML for the feature body (takes precedence over `description`). |
| `id` | `string` | — | Host element `id` (React, Vue, and Astro HTML attributes). |

### StatblockSection

_Source: `apps/storybook/src/domain/molecules/StatblockSection/StatblockSection.mdx` · [Storybook](/?path=/docs/domain-molecules-statblocksection--docs)_

**Why:** Grouping features under a real H2 keeps the outline contiguous under the creature H1 and gives a clear landmark for Actions, Reactions, Legendary Actions, and similar clusters.

**When:** **Do:** Actions, bonus actions, reactions, legendary / lair actions, traits clusters. Reuse outside a full Statblock when a rules page only needs one section. Pass product copy for `title` (*Toiminnot*, *Reaktiot*) — no DS enums. **Don't:** Don’t use H3 or H5 for the section title inside a Statblock — that breaks H1 → H2 → H3. Don’t put feature bodies directly under the H2 without StatblockFeature (loses run-in + remap). Don’t invent a second visual heading scale; remap happens here via Tier 3 bridges.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `string` | — | Section heading (visual meso H3). |
| `titleLevel` | `2 \| 3 \| 4` | `2` | Semantic heading tag level (`3` or `4` when embedded under H2/H3). |
| `bodyHtml` | `string` | — | Optional introductory HTML before `features`. |
| `features` | `StatblockFeatureProps[]` | — | Stacked feature entries (default `level` cascades to `titleLevel + 1`). |

### AbilityScoreGroup

_Source: `apps/storybook/src/domain/organisms/AbilityScoreGroup/AbilityScoreGroup.mdx` · [Storybook](/?path=/docs/domain-organisms-abilityscoregroup--docs)_

**Why:** Ability grids need a panel, noise surface, scoop corners, and a container query. AbilityScore owns one column; AbilityScoreGroup owns the sandwich layout.

**When:** **Do:** Put vitals in `header` and details in `footer` as PropertyLists. Compose from AbilityScore columns — never invent a display:`table` reordering hack. Use explicit slots instead of `:has(+.wrapper)` sibling styling. **Don't:** Don’t put the creature name or section headings here — those live on Statblock. Don’t use Badge for ability numbers — Stat is content display.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `abilities` | `AbilityScoreProps[]` | — | Columns. |
| `header` | HTML string / `ReactNode` / Vue & Astro `header` slot | — | Inset rail (typically PropertyList). |
| `footer` | HTML string / `ReactNode` / Vue & Astro `footer` slot | — | Inset rail (typically PropertyList). |

### ContentGate

_Source: `apps/storybook/src/domain/organisms/ContentGate/ContentGate.mdx` · [Storybook](/?path=/docs/domain-organisms-contentgate--docs)_

**Why:** Gating a document needs a consistent, accessible explanation: what is locked, why, and what to do. A live status region announces async results without relying on colour.

**When:** - Use when the reader cannot access a document and no public fallback exists. - The status line is hidden until `statusMessage` is set. - Put developer-only controls in the `footer` slot.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `readinessLabel` / `readinessIntent` | `string` / `BadgeIntent` | **required** | Readiness Badge label and intent. |
| `lockLabel` | `string` | `'Locked'` | Accessible label for the lock Icon. |
| `title` / `titleLevel` | `string` / `1 \| 2 \| 3` | **required** / `2` | Gate heading text and tag level. |
| `description` / `descriptionHtml` | `string` | — | Plain-text or trusted HTML explanatory copy (or default slot/children). |
| `currentTierLabel` / `requiredTierLabel` | `string` | **required** | Comparison pill values. |
| `currentTierPrefix` / `requiredTierPrefix` | `string` | `'Current tier:'` / `'Required tier:'` | Localised comparison prefixes. |
| `statusMessage` | `string` | — | Live-region text; hidden when empty. |
| `actions` / `footer` | `string` / slot | — | Primary action buttons and optional dev-only footer. |
| `id` | `string` | — | Host `<section id>`. |

### EquipmentBlock

_Source: `apps/storybook/src/domain/organisms/EquipmentBlock/EquipmentBlock.mdx` · [Storybook](/?path=/docs/domain-organisms-equipmentblock--docs)_

**Why:** Rules and compendium pages need a standardized, accessible display card for equipment:

**When:** **Do:** Use for presenting individual weapons, armor, shields, or equipment in rules catalogs and compendiums. Use as the live preview card inside interactive crafters or workshops (such as `EquipmentWorkshop`). Pass Finnish game terminology as props and data. **Don't:** Don't build one-off Frankenstein cards with arbitrary ad-hoc tables and inline styles. Don't hardcode rule math or Finnish strings in CSS or component class names. Don't use generic Card when an equipment entity with stats, kesto, and traits is being rendered.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `string` | — | Equipment name. |
| `nameLevel` | `1 \| 2` | `1` | Heading level for the name (use `2` when embedded). |
| `category` | `string` | — | Category/type line (e.g. `Sota-ase · Lähitaistelu`). |
| `price` | `string` | — | Price string formatted with currency (e.g. `20 kr`). |
| `stats` | `EquipmentStatItem[]` | — | Array of stat items (supports `emphasis`, `subValue`, `subItems`, `abilities`). |
| `kesto` | `EquipmentKestoBreakdown` | — | Optional damage resistance breakdown. |
| `traits` | `string[]` | — | Array of trait names displayed as chips. |
| `emptyTraitsText` | `string` | `'Ei erikoispiirteitä'` | Placeholder when no traits are selected. |
| `traitsTitle` | `string` | `'Valitut piirteet'` | Title for traits section. |
| `notesTitle` | `string` | `'Säännöt & vaikutukset'` | Title for notes section. |
| `notes` | `string[]` | — | Rules and special effects paragraphs. |
| `warnings` | `string[]` | — | Validation or budget warning messages. |
| `copyText` | `string` | — | Text to copy to clipboard. |
| `copyLabel` | `string` | `'Kopioi hahmolomakkeelle'` | Label for the copy button. |
| `showCopyButton` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether to show the copy button in footer. |
| `id` | `string` | — | Optional anchor `id` on `<article>` (React, Vue, and Astro HTML attributes). |

### EquipmentWorkshop

_Source: `apps/storybook/src/domain/organisms/EquipmentWorkshop/EquipmentWorkshop.mdx` · [Storybook](/?path=/docs/domain-organisms-equipmentworkshop--docs)_

**Why:** Crafting tools need a responsive split workbench (controls on the inline-start rail, sticky `EquipmentBlock` preview on the inline-end rail, optional header/toolbar/footer) without hardcoding game math into `@eevenkoto/core` or inventing ad-hoc flex/grid wrappers per builder.

**When:** Use `EquipmentWorkshop` for weapon, armor, and item builders paired with `EquipmentBlock`. For generic creature, encounter, or random-table generators that do not need the equipment control-group helpers, use Core [Workshop](/?path=/docs/core-organisms-workshop--docs) directly.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `layout` | `'split' \| 'inline'` | `'split'` | Workbench geometry (`'split'` 2-column or `'inline'` single-column). |
| `sticky` | `'preview' \| 'controls' \| 'none'` | `'preview'` (`'none'` in `inline`) | Sticky column behavior above `56rem` container width. |
| `header` | `ReactNode \| string` | — | Top header bar (title, mode switcher, preset picker). |
| `controls` | `ReactNode \| string` | — | Inline-start form controls column (or children / default slot). |
| `toolbar` | `ReactNode \| string` | — | Optional sunken summary/export bar above `preview`. |
| `preview` | `ReactNode \| string` | — | Inline-end live preview rail (typically `EquipmentBlock`). |
| `footer` | `ReactNode \| string` | — | Optional top-bordered footer tray below the body. |
| `id` | `string` | — | Explicit host element `id` (React, Vue, and Astro HTML attributes). |
| `idSuffix` | `string` | — | Appends `equipment-workshop{idSuffix}` as the host `id`. |

### Spellblock

_Source: `apps/storybook/src/domain/organisms/Spellblock/Spellblock.mdx` · [Storybook](/?path=/docs/domain-organisms-spellblock--docs)_

**Why:** Spell pages need the same structure a printed spell has: find the school line, then Range and Duration, then read the effect. Spellblock gives you one organism that:

**When:** **Do:** Spell entries on rules pages, and spell catalogs via `deck`. Keep level, school, ritual tags, and component copy in the product — map them into props. Put the whole level/school string in `typeLine`, exactly as it is printed. **Don't:** Don’t rebuild the legacy `<strong>Kantama:</strong>` + `<br>` paragraph block. Don’t add school / ritual / concentration enums to `@eevenkoto/core` — they are strings. Don’t use Spellblock for creatures — that is [Statblock](/?path=/docs/domain-organisms-statblock--docs). Don’t nest a Spellblock inside a Core Card; the organism already owns its surface.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | — | Optional anchor `id` applied to the outer `<article>`. |
| `headingId` | `string` | — | Optional anchor `id` applied to the spell name heading. |
| `name` | `string` | — | Spell name. |
| `nameHtml` | `string` | — | Trusted inline HTML for the spell name heading (sanitized in HTML renderer). Takes precedence over `name`. |
| `nameLevel` | `1 \| 2 \| 3` | `1` | Heading level for the name (`2` or `3` in embeds; scaling features cascade to `nameLevel + 1`). |
| `typeLine` | `string` | — | Italic level / school line on the plate. |
| `typeLineHtml` | `string` | — | Trusted inline HTML for the type line (takes precedence over `typeLine`). |
| `classes` | `PropertyItem[]` | — | Optional catalog rail under the type line. |
| `properties` | `PropertyItem[]` | — | Casting time, range, components, duration. |
| `paragraphs` | `string[]` | — | Effect prose, one entry per paragraph. |
| `paragraphsHtml` | `string[]` | — | Trusted inline HTML entries for effect paragraphs (takes precedence over `paragraphs`). |
| `bodyHtml` | `string` | — | Trusted pre-rendered HTML for `__body` (e.g. Markdown output with embedded tables/lists; takes precedence over `paragraphsHtml`). |
| `features` | `StatblockFeatureProps[]` | — | Scaling run-ins. Default `level` cascades from `nameLevel` (`2`, `3`, or `4`). |
| `deck` | `boolean` | `false` | Compact card for grids. |
| `lang` | `string` | — | BCP 47 tag on the article; enables `hyphens: auto`. |

### Statblock

_Source: `apps/storybook/src/domain/organisms/Statblock/Statblock.mdx` · [Storybook](/?path=/docs/domain-organisms-statblock--docs)_

**Why:** Rules pages need a stable, accessible structure for NPC and monster entries. Statblock gives you one organism that:

**When:** **Do:** Full NPC, monster, or archetype entries in rules docs. Keep ability names, vitals labels, and feature copy in the product — map them into props. Compose from smaller molecules when you only need a grid, a section, or a single feature. **Don't:** Don’t revive the Markdown `<table class="kykylistaus-table">` + sibling-paragraph sandwich. Don’t put Finnish ability enums or CR math into `@eevenkoto/core`. Don’t skip heading levels for style (e.g. H1 → H6) — use H2 / H3 run-in; visuals remap on the molecules. Don’t use Statblock for generic page chrome — it is an entry organism, not a Card.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | — | Optional anchor `id` applied to the outer `<article>`. |
| `headingId` | `string` | — | Optional anchor `id` applied to the creature name heading. |
| `name` | `string` | — | Creature / entity title. |
| `nameHtml` | `string` | — | Trusted inline HTML for the creature name heading (sanitized in HTML renderer). Takes precedence over `name`. |
| `nameLevel` | `1 \| 2 \| 3` | `1` | Heading level for the name (`2` or `3` in embedded outlines; cascades section `titleLevel` and feature `level`). |
| `flavor` | `string` | — | Optional flavor Paragraph. |
| `flavorHtml` | `string` | — | Trusted inline HTML for the flavor Paragraph (takes precedence over `flavor`). |
| `typeLine` | `string` | — | Optional italic type line. |
| `typeLineHtml` | `string` | — | Trusted inline HTML for the type line (takes precedence over `typeLine`). |
| `vitals` | `PropertyItem[]` | — | Combat vitals → AbilityScoreGroup header. |
| `abilities` | `AbilityScoreProps[]` | — | Ability columns. |
| `details` | `PropertyItem[]` | — | Skills / senses / languages / CR → footer. |
| `sections` | `StatblockSectionProps[]` | — | Actions, reactions, etc. |
| `bodyHtml` | `string` | — | Trusted pre-rendered HTML rendered after `AbilityScoreGroup` when `sections` are pre-rendered or supplemented by Markdown. |
